namespace F6SeamPreship
open Turing

/-- Pure layout reconstruction for the last-ruler route. The three H2-F tapes
occupy the first three of K+3 bank tapes; H5 adds the ruler last. No run/cut
premise for the unfinished header/startup prefix is supplied by this equation. -/
theorem last_ruler_layout (K n ℓ : ℕ) {P Q V : Type}
    (finish : P) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x z : List Bool)
    (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) :
    let σ : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let ec := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    let bank : Cfg (K + 3) Bool P x :=
      ⟨some finish, 1,
        fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
          else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
          else fun _ => none,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    let physical : Cfg ((K + 3) + 1) Bool P z :=
      ⟨some finish, ⟨ℓ + 1, by omega⟩,
        Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    physical.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) =
      rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec
        (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0 := by
  intro σ ec bank physical
  dsimp only [physical]
  have h1 (j : Fin (K + 3)) : (j = 1) ↔ j.val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.ext_iff]
    change j.val = 1 % (K + 3) ↔ j.val = 1
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < K + 3)]
  have h2 (j : Fin (K + 3)) : (j = 2) ↔ j.val = 2 := by
    rw [Fin.ext_iff]
    change j.val = 2 % (K + 3) ↔ j.val = 2
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < K + 3)]
  have hbank : ec = bank.mapState (fun _ => entry) := by
    have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) finish entry M x
    simpa only [ec, bank, σ, h1, h2] using h
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, rulerHostCfg_state, hbank, Cfg.mapState_state]
    all_goals rfl
  · apply Fin.ext
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, (rulerHostCfg_fields ℓ hz _ ec _ 0).1,
      hbank, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
    simp only [bank, Fin.val_one]
  · funext i p
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, rulerHostCfg_workTapes, hbank]
    change Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes i p =
      Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool)
        (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) (bank.mapState (fun _ => entry)).workTapes i p
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
    · simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
  · funext i
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, rulerHostCfg_workTapePos, hbank]
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [Fin.lastCases_last]
    · rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, rulerHostCfg_output, hbank, Cfg.mapState_output]


/-- The full-bank emitting embedding at the zero-outer-frame specialization
is reconstructed by the existing public configuration contract. -/
theorem full_bank_embedding {m : ℕ} {Q : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) :
    embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (le_refl m)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c = c := by
  apply embedEmitCfg_eq
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact List.nil_append _
  · intro i
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro j hj
    exact False.elim (hj ⟨j, rfl⟩)

/-- Equality induction transports the indexed operations without opening them. -/
private theorem cast_init_run {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).runFrom
      ((h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).initCfg z) t =
        (h ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) t : Cfg n Bool P z) := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_init_space {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).spaceUsed
      ((h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).initCfg z) t =
        A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) t := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_cfg_state {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool P z) : (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool P z).state = c.state := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_cfg_mapState {P Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool P z) (f : P → Q) :
    (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool P z).mapState f = (h ▸ c.mapState f : Cfg n Bool Q z) := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_cfg_embedding {Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) :
    (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool Q z) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq h)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c := by
  cases h
  exact (full_bank_embedding c).symm

private theorem cast_back_embedding {Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) :
    (h.symm ▸ embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq h))
      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c : Cfg m Bool Q z) = c := by
  cases h
  exact full_bank_embedding c

/-- Conditional consumer at the actual last-ruler endpoint. Prefix run/cut/space
and the hosted loop's per-tape bound are explicit OWN inputs, not asserted facts. -/
theorem conditional_final_seam (K n ℓ : ℕ) {P Q V : Type} [DecidableEq P]
    (A : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool P) (finish : P)
    (H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool V) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x z : List Bool)
    (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) :
    let σ : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let ec := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    let bank : Cfg (K + 3) Bool P x :=
      ⟨some finish, 1,
        fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
          else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
          else fun _ => none,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    let d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool P z :=
      ⟨some finish, ⟨ℓ + 1, by omega⟩,
        Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    let c := rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec
      (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0
    ∀ (T t B S : ℕ),
      (aRun : A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) T = d) →
      (aCut : ∀ u < T, (A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some finish) →
      (hB : A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) T ≤ B) →
      (hS : 1 ≤ S) →
      (hloop : ∀ i, H.spaceUsedByTape c t i ≤ S) →
      let A0 : MultiTapeTM (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P :=
        (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)).symm ▸ A
      let U0 := startupLoopTM (k := K + 2) (K := 0) A0 finish H (inj entry false)
      let U : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) :=
        (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)) ▸ U0
      U.runFrom (U.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) = (H.runFrom c t).mapState Sum.inr ∧
        U.spaceUsed (U.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) ≤ B + (K + 4) * S := by
  intro σ ec bank d c T t B S aRun aCut hB hS hloop A0 U0 U
  have hexit : d.state = some finish := rfl
  have hphysical : d.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) = c :=
    last_ruler_layout K n ℓ finish entry inj M x z hz
  have hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (le_refl (K + 4)))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c :=
    hphysical.trans (full_bank_embedding c).symm
  let e : (K + 4) = 0 + ((K + 2) + 2) := (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)).symm
  let d0 : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z := e ▸ d
  have aRun0 : A0.runFrom (A0.initCfg z) T = d0 := by
    calc
      _ = (e ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) T : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z) :=
        cast_init_run e A z T
      _ = d0 := congrArg (fun v : Cfg (K + 4) Bool P z =>
        (e ▸ v : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z)) aRun
  have hexit0 : d0.state = some finish := (cast_cfg_state e d).trans hexit
  have aCut0 : ∀ u < T, (A0.runFrom (A0.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some finish := by
    intro u hu
    rw [show A0.runFrom (A0.initCfg z) u =
      (e ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) u : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z) from
        cast_init_run e A z u, cast_cfg_state]
    exact aCut u hu
  have hcfg0 : d0.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : (K + 2) + 2 ≤ 0 + ((K + 2) + 2)))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c := by
    calc
      _ = (e ▸ d.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) :
          Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool V z) := cast_cfg_mapState e d _
      _ = (e ▸ c : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool V z) :=
        congrArg (fun v : Cfg (K + 4) Bool V z =>
          (e ▸ v : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool V z)) hphysical
      _ = _ := cast_cfg_embedding e c
  have hB0 : A0.spaceUsed (A0.initCfg z) T ≤ B :=
    (cast_init_space e A z T).trans_le hB
  have hr := startupLoopTM_runFrom (k := K + 2) (K := 0)
    A0 finish H (inj entry false) c d0 T aRun0 hexit0 aCut0 hcfg0 t
  have hs := startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le (k := K + 2) (K := 0)
    A0 finish H (inj entry false) c d0 T aRun0 hexit0 aCut0 hcfg0 t B S hB0 hS hloop
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = (e.symm ▸ U0.runFrom (U0.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) z) :=
        cast_init_run e.symm U0 z (T + 1 + t)
      _ = (e.symm ▸ (embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq e))
          (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (H.runFrom c t)).mapState Sum.inr :
            Cfg (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) z) :=
        congrArg (fun v : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool (P ⊕ V) z =>
          (e.symm ▸ v : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) z)) hr
      _ = _ := by rw [← cast_cfg_mapState, cast_back_embedding]
  · calc
      _ = U0.spaceUsed (U0.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) :=
        cast_init_space e.symm U0 z (T + 1 + t)
      _ ≤ B + (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) * S := hs
      _ = B + (K + 4) * S := by rw [Nat.zero_add]

end F6SeamPreship

namespace F6SeamPreship
open Turing

/-- Pure layout reconstruction for the last-ruler route. The three H2-F tapes
occupy the first three of K+3 bank tapes; H5 adds the ruler last. No run/cut
premise for the unfinished header/startup prefix is supplied by this equation. -/
theorem last_ruler_layout (K n ℓ : ℕ) {P Q V : Type}
    (finish : P) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x z : List Bool)
    (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) :
    let σ : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let ec := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    let bank : Cfg (K + 3) Bool P x :=
      ⟨some finish, 1,
        fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
          else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
          else fun _ => none,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    let physical : Cfg ((K + 3) + 1) Bool P z :=
      ⟨some finish, ⟨ℓ + 1, by omega⟩,
        Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    physical.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) =
      rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec
        (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0 := by
  intro σ ec bank physical
  dsimp only [physical]
  have h1 (j : Fin (K + 3)) : (j = 1) ↔ j.val = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.ext_iff]
    change j.val = 1 % (K + 3) ↔ j.val = 1
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < K + 3)]
  have h2 (j : Fin (K + 3)) : (j = 2) ↔ j.val = 2 := by
    rw [Fin.ext_iff]
    change j.val = 2 % (K + 3) ↔ j.val = 2
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < K + 3)]
  have hbank : ec = bank.mapState (fun _ => entry) := by
    have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) finish entry M x
    simpa only [ec, bank, σ, h1, h2] using h
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, rulerHostCfg_state, hbank, Cfg.mapState_state]
    all_goals rfl
  · apply Fin.ext
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, (rulerHostCfg_fields ℓ hz _ ec _ 0).1,
      hbank, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
    simp only [bank, Fin.val_one]
  · funext i p
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, rulerHostCfg_workTapes, hbank]
    change Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes i p =
      Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool)
        (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) (bank.mapState (fun _ => entry)).workTapes i p
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
    · simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
  · funext i
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, rulerHostCfg_workTapePos, hbank]
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [Fin.lastCases_last]
    · rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, rulerHostCfg_output, hbank, Cfg.mapState_output]


/-- The full-bank emitting embedding at the zero-outer-frame specialization
is reconstructed by the existing public configuration contract. -/
theorem full_bank_embedding {m : ℕ} {Q : Type} {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) :
    embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (le_refl m)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c = c := by
  apply embedEmitCfg_eq
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact List.nil_append _
  · intro i
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro j hj
    exact False.elim (hj ⟨j, rfl⟩)

/-- Equality induction transports the indexed operations without opening them. -/
private theorem cast_init_run {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).runFrom
      ((h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).initCfg z) t =
        (h ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) t : Cfg n Bool P z) := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_init_space {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    (A : MultiTapeTM m Bool P) (z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).spaceUsed
      ((h ▸ A : MultiTapeTM n Bool P).initCfg z) t =
        A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) t := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_cfg_state {P : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool P z) : (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool P z).state = c.state := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_cfg_mapState {P Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool P z) (f : P → Q) :
    (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool P z).mapState f = (h ▸ c.mapState f : Cfg n Bool Q z) := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem cast_cfg_embedding {Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) :
    (h ▸ c : Cfg n Bool Q z) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq h)) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c := by
  cases h
  exact (full_bank_embedding c).symm

private theorem cast_back_embedding {Q : Type} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {z : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg m Bool Q z) :
    (h.symm ▸ embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq h))
      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c : Cfg m Bool Q z) = c := by
  cases h
  exact full_bank_embedding c

/-- Conditional consumer at the actual last-ruler endpoint. Prefix run/cut/space
and the hosted loop's per-tape bound are explicit OWN inputs, not asserted facts.

**Proof sketch.** Reconstruct the complete last-ruler endpoint via public fields,
transport the prefix and endpoint along zero-addition by equality induction,
apply the published seam run and per-tape space contracts, then transport their
conclusions back to the physical bank. No OWN premise is proved here. -/
theorem conditional_final_seam (K n ℓ : ℕ) {P Q V : Type} [DecidableEq P]
    (A : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool P) (finish : P)
    (H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool V) (entry : Q) (inj : Q → Bool → V)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x z : List Bool)
    (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) :
    let σ : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let ec := embedEmitCfg σ (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    let bank : Cfg (K + 3) Bool P x :=
      ⟨some finish, 1,
        fun j => if j = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
          else if j = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
          else fun _ => none,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    let d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool P z :=
      ⟨some finish, ⟨ℓ + 1, by omega⟩,
        Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) bank.workTapes,
        fun _ => 0, []⟩
    let c := rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (ec.state.map fun q => inj q false) ec
      (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0
    ∀ (T t B S : ℕ),
      (aRun : A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) T = d) →
      (aCut : ∀ u < T, (A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some finish) →
      (hB : A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) T ≤ B) →
      (hS : 1 ≤ S) →
      (hloop : ∀ i, H.spaceUsedByTape c t i ≤ S) →
      let A0 : MultiTapeTM (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P :=
        (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)).symm ▸ A
      let U0 := startupLoopTM (k := K + 2) (K := 0) A0 finish H (inj entry false)
      let U : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) :=
        (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)) ▸ U0
      U.runFrom (U.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) = (H.runFrom c t).mapState Sum.inr ∧
        U.spaceUsed (U.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) ≤ B + (K + 4) * S := by
  intro σ ec bank d c T t B S aRun aCut hB hS hloop A0 U0 U
  have hexit : d.state = some finish := rfl
  have hphysical : d.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) = c :=
    last_ruler_layout K n ℓ finish entry inj M x z hz
  have hcfg : d.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (le_refl (K + 4)))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c :=
    hphysical.trans (full_bank_embedding c).symm
  let e : (K + 4) = 0 + ((K + 2) + 2) := (Nat.zero_add ((K + 2) + 2)).symm
  let d0 : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z := e ▸ d
  have aRun0 : A0.runFrom (A0.initCfg z) T = d0 := by
    calc
      _ = (e ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) T : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z) :=
        cast_init_run e A z T
      _ = d0 := congrArg (fun v : Cfg (K + 4) Bool P z =>
        (e ▸ v : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z)) aRun
  have hexit0 : d0.state = some finish := (cast_cfg_state e d).trans hexit
  have aCut0 : ∀ u < T, (A0.runFrom (A0.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some finish := by
    intro u hu
    rw [show A0.runFrom (A0.initCfg z) u =
      (e ▸ A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) u : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool P z) from
        cast_init_run e A z u, cast_cfg_state]
    exact aCut u hu
  have hcfg0 : d0.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) =
      embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : (K + 2) + 2 ≤ 0 + ((K + 2) + 2)))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] c := by
    calc
      _ = (e ▸ d.mapState (fun _ => inj entry false) :
          Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool V z) := cast_cfg_mapState e d _
      _ = (e ▸ c : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool V z) :=
        congrArg (fun v : Cfg (K + 4) Bool V z =>
          (e ▸ v : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool V z)) hphysical
      _ = _ := cast_cfg_embedding e c
  have hB0 : A0.spaceUsed (A0.initCfg z) T ≤ B :=
    (cast_init_space e A z T).trans_le hB
  have hr := startupLoopTM_runFrom (k := K + 2) (K := 0)
    A0 finish H (inj entry false) c d0 T aRun0 hexit0 aCut0 hcfg0 t
  have hs := startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le (k := K + 2) (K := 0)
    A0 finish H (inj entry false) c d0 T aRun0 hexit0 aCut0 hcfg0 t B S hB0 hS hloop
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = (e.symm ▸ U0.runFrom (U0.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) z) :=
        cast_init_run e.symm U0 z (T + 1 + t)
      _ = (e.symm ▸ (embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.le_of_eq e))
          (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (H.runFrom c t)).mapState Sum.inr :
            Cfg (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) z) :=
        congrArg (fun v : Cfg (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) Bool (P ⊕ V) z =>
          (e.symm ▸ v : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (P ⊕ V) z)) hr
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← cast_cfg_mapState, cast_back_embedding]
        exact e
  · calc
      _ = U0.spaceUsed (U0.initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) :=
        cast_init_space e.symm U0 z (T + 1 + t)
      _ ≤ B + (0 + ((K + 2) + 2)) * S := hs
      _ = B + (K + 4) * S := by rw [Nat.zero_add]

/-- The suggested common loop budget is positive without a source-space premise.
This arithmetic fact does not establish its per-tape bound. -/
theorem common_budget_positive (s D ℓ : ℕ) : 1 ≤ s + (2 * D + 1) + ℓ + 3 := by
  omega

/-- Consumer of the implemented, still-unmerged prerequisite reader, with
CodeTM.toFinTM sealed before this header. No assumed reader hypothesis. -/
theorem actual_bundle_consumer (M : CodeTM) (x output : List Bool) (t s : ℕ)
    (hcomp : M.toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t)
    (hspace : M.toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed (M.toFinTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s) :
    (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output = output ∧
      M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s := by
  rw [CodeTM.toFinTM_eq] at hcomp hspace
  obtain ⟨halted, out⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff
    { k := 1, State := Fin (M.numStates + 1), tm := M.tm } x output t).mp hcomp
  exact ⟨halted, out, hspace⟩


end F6SeamPreship

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/final-seam-preship-v5/metadata-appendix.lean.txt =====


/-! Read-only compiled inventory of the eleven bounded proof roots and their descendants.
Imported theorem proof values are not traversed. Existing same-home legacy helpers remain
outside the changed proof scope. Root types and compiled values are both inspected. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List String := ["last_ruler_layout", "full_bank_embedding", "cast_init_run", "cast_init_space", "cast_cfg_state", "cast_cfg_mapState", "cast_cfg_embedding", "cast_back_embedding", "conditional_final_seam", "common_budget_positive", "actual_bundle_consumer"]
  let kind := fun (ci : ConstantInfo) => match ci with
    | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom" | .defnInfo _ => "definition" | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
    | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient" | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
    | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    match n with
    | .str _ base => if wanted.contains base then roots := roots.push n
    | _ => pure ()
  if roots.size != wanted.length then
    throwError "Root count mismatch: {roots.size} for {wanted.length} source roots"
  for root in roots.qsort Name.lt do
    logInfo m!"ROOT|{root}|private={isPrivateName root}"
  let mut selected : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    if roots.any (fun r => r.isPrefixOf n) then selected := selected.push n
  for n in selected.qsort Name.lt do
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "selected constant missing {n}"
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
    logInfo m!"PROOFAX|{n}|kind={kind ci}|{(axs.qsort Name.lt).toList}"
    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do
      if seen.contains c then continue
      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with
      | some j, some (.defnInfo di) =>
        let owner := env.header.moduleNames[j.toNat]!
        if (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf owner then
          let hint := match di.hints with
            | .abbrev => "abbrev" | .opaque => "opaque" | .regular _ => "regular"
          logInfo m!"FOREIGNDEF|{n}|{c}|{owner}|hints={hint}"
      | none, some (.defnInfo _) =>
        logInfo m!"HOMEDEF|{n}|{c}"
      | _, _ => pure ()

```
from pathlib import Path
import collections, datetime, hashlib, json, re

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD = OUT.parent / 'layout-preship-v2'
ALLOWED = {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

runs = []
for receipt in sorted(OUT.glob('*-run.json')):
    name = receipt.name.removesuffix('-run.json')
    row = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
    assert digest(OUT / (name + '.lean.txt')) == row['input_sha256']
    assert digest(OUT / (name + '.out')) == row['output_sha256']
    assert digest(Path(row['command'][-1])) == row['input_sha256']
    output = (OUT / (name + '.out')).read_text()
    errors = re.findall(r'^.*:\d+:\d+: error(?:\([^)]*\))?:', output, re.M)
    assert len(errors) == row['errors']
    runs.append(dict(name=name, exit=row['exit'], errors=len(errors),
                     seconds=row['seconds'], warnings=len(re.findall(r': warning:', output))))

for name in ['Seam-sealed-v5', 'Final-native', 'Final-sealed', 'Controls-native']:
    row = next(r for r in runs if r['name'] == name)
    assert row['exit'] == 0 and row['errors'] == 0 and row['warnings'] == 0
    assert 'sorryAx' not in (OUT / (name + '.out')).read_text()

sealed = (OUT / 'Final-sealed.lean.txt').read_text()
native = (OUT / 'Final-native.lean.txt').read_text()
guard = (OUT / 'guard.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0] + '\n'
assert sealed.count(guard) == 1
assert sealed.replace(guard, '') == native
assert sealed.index(guard) < sealed.index('/-- Pure layout')
assert 'attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg' in sealed

text = (OUT / 'Final-sealed.out').read_text()
roots = re.findall(r'^ROOT\|([^|]+)\|private=(true|false)$', text, re.M)
axioms = re.findall(r'^PROOFAX\|([^|]+)\|kind=([^|]+)\|\[([^]]*)\]', text, re.M)
defs = re.findall(r'^FOREIGNDEF\|([^|]+)\|([^|]+)\|([^|]+)\|hints=(\w+)$', text, re.M)
assert len(roots) == 11
assert len({n for n, _ in roots}) == 11
for name, kind, raw in axioms:
    assert kind == 'theorem'
    assert {x.strip() for x in raw.split(',') if x.strip()} <= ALLOWED
guards = json.loads((OUT / 'seal-inventory.json').read_text())['definitions']
ordinary = sorted({d for _, d, _, hint in defs if hint != 'abbrev'})
abbreviations = sorted({d for _, d, _, hint in defs if hint == 'abbrev'})
assert not set(ordinary) - set(guards)
inventory = dict(
    roots=[dict(name=n, private=v == 'true') for n, v in roots],
    roots_count=len(roots),
    selected_including_descendants=[dict(name=n, kind=k, axioms=[x.strip() for x in a.split(',') if x.strip()])
                                    for n, k, a in axioms],
    selected_count=len(axioms),
    direct_foreign_definitions=[dict(root=r, definition=d, owner=m, hints=h) for r, d, m, h in defs],
    ordinary_definitions=ordinary, abbrev_projection_exclusions=abbreviations,
    all_direct_ordinary_defs_guarded=True, guard_count=len(guards),
    scope='All11 scratch roots and prefix-named compiler descendants; direct types/values; imported theorem proofs opaque. Guard32 is conservative.')
(OUT / 'compiled-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + '\n')

cs = (OUT / 'Controls-sealed.lean.txt').read_text()
cn = (OUT / 'Controls-native.lean.txt').read_text()
assert cs.replace(guard, '') == cn
decls = [(m.group(1), cs[:m.start()].count('\n') + 1)
         for m in re.finditer(r'^theorem (control_\d+)', cs, re.M)]
assert len(decls) == 64
raw_errors = [(int(m.group(1)), m.group(3)) for m in re.finditer(
    r'^.*:(\d+):(\d+): error(?:\([^)]*\))?: (.*)$',
    (OUT / 'Controls-sealed.out').read_text(), re.M)]
old_index = json.loads((OLD / 'controls-index.json').read_text())
assert len(old_index) == 32
count = collections.Counter()
rows = []
for line, msg in raw_errors:
    assert msg.startswith('Tactic `rfl` failed')
    owners = [name for i, (name, start) in enumerate(decls)
              if start <= line < (decls[i+1][1] if i+1 < len(decls) else 100000)]
    assert len(owners) == 1
    count[owners[0]] += 1
assert set(count) == {n for n, _ in decls}
for i, (name, start) in enumerate(decls):
    assert count[name] == 1
    definition = old_index[i // 2]['definition']
    assert definition in guards
    stop = decls[i+1][1] if i+1 < len(decls) else 100000
    rows.append(dict(name='F6SeamControls.' + name, definition=definition,
                     mode='pointwise' if i % 2 == 0 else 'abstracted',
                     sealed_start_line=start, sealed_error_lines=[l for l, _ in raw_errors if start <= l < stop]))
assert {r['definition'] for r in rows} == set(guards)
assert len(raw_errors) == 64
assert next(r for r in runs if r['name'] == 'Controls-sealed')['exit'] == 1
native_controls = re.findall(r"^'F6SeamControls\.(control_\d+)' (?:depends on axioms: \[([^]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)",
                             (OUT / 'Controls-native.out').read_text(), re.M)
assert len(native_controls) == 64
assert {n for n, _ in native_controls} == {n for n, _ in decls}
for _, raw in native_controls:
    assert {x.strip() for x in raw.split(',') if x.strip()} <= ALLOWED
(OUT / 'controls-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')

context = json.loads((OUT / 'context.json').read_text())
pins = []
for row in context['files']:
    a = digest(Path(row['source_path'])) == row['source_sha256']
    b = digest(Path(row['olean_path'])) == row['olean_sha256']
    assert a and b
    pins.append(dict(module=row['module'], source_unchanged=a, compiled_unchanged=b))

result = dict(
    checked_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    status='PASS bounded conditional last-ruler final seam only; F6 remains unissued',
    runs=runs, roots=len(roots), roots_and_descendants=len(axioms),
    ordinary_definitions=len(ordinary), abbrev_projection_exclusions=len(abbreviations),
    guard_definitions=len(guards), native_sealed_guard_only_difference=True,
    controls=dict(definitions=32, native_theorems=64, sealed_errors=64,
                  exactly_one_expected_rfl_failure_per_identity=True),
    pin_checks=pins, initial_context_capture_after_v1_to_v5=True,
    no_source_Git_cache_snapshot_screen_or_target_admission_mutations=True,
    limit='No actual prefix/run/cut/hB/hloop proof, universal machine/target fill, merged-tree replay, dispatch or prerequisite merge attestation.')
(OUT / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ['status', 'runs', 'roots', 'roots_and_descendants', 'ordinary_definitions', 'abbrev_projection_exclusions', 'controls']}, indent=2))
```

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/first-header-preship-v3/Controls-sealed-v1.lean.txt =====

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.MultiTapeTM.step Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.Cfg.init Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols Turing.moveInputPos Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime Turing.FinTM.Computes Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead Turing.FinTM.controlAction Turing.FinTM.leftAction Turing.FinTM.rightAction Turing.FinTM.emitAction Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.Cfg.mapState Turing.seamCompTM Turing.embedEmitTM Turing.embedEmitRetTM Turing.embedEmitCfg Turing.rulerHostCfg Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg Turing.startupLoopTM Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM Turing.pairEncode Turing.tableBitsK Turing.unaryFin Turing.tapeAction Turing.headerRulerTM Turing.headerScanTM
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg

/-! Kernel-checked direct Eq.refl controls. Pointwise goals project a data field
for structure-valued definitions; abstracted goals compare the whole defining function.
Every failure has its own definition/mode identifier; no failed proof is admitted. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
elab "#f6_first_header_controls" : command => do
  let names : List Name := [`Turing.MultiTapeTM.step,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
    `Turing.Cfg.init,
    `Turing.Action.apply,
    `Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol,
    `Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
    `Turing.moveInputPos,
    `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime,
    `Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime,
    `Turing.FinTM.Computes,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead,
    `Turing.FinTM.controlAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.leftAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.rightAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.emitAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape,
    `Turing.Cfg.mapState,
    `Turing.seamCompTM,
    `Turing.embedEmitTM,
    `Turing.embedEmitRetTM,
    `Turing.embedEmitCfg,
    `Turing.rulerHostCfg,
    `Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg,
    `Turing.startupLoopTM,
    `Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM,
    `Turing.pairEncode,
    `Turing.tableBitsK,
    `Turing.unaryFin,
    `Turing.tapeAction,
    `Turing.headerRulerTM,
    `Turing.headerScanTM]
  let mut index := 0
  for n in names do
    let some (.defnInfo di) := (← getEnv).find? n | throwError "not a definition {n}"
    for mode in ["point", "abstract"] do
      index := index + 1
      let pair ← liftTermElabM do
        let levels := di.levelParams.map Level.param
        let head := mkConst n levels
        let solve := fun (lhs rhs : Expr) => do
          let goalType ← mkEq lhs rhs
          let goal ← mkFreshExprSyntheticOpaqueMVar goalType
          try
            goal.mvarId!.refl
            let value ← instantiateMVars goal
            pure (some (goalType, value))
          catch ex =>
            logInfo m!"CONTROL|{n}|{mode}|FAIL"
            logError m!"RFL_CONTROL|{n}|{mode}|{ex.toMessageData}"
            pure none
        if mode == "abstract" then
          solve head di.value
        else
          forallTelescope di.type fun xs resultType => do
            let mut lhs := mkAppN head xs
            let mut rhs := (mkAppN di.value xs).headBeta
            -- Projection goals are distinct from the complete equation even for nullary data.
            match resultType.getAppFn with
            | .const ``Turing.FinTM _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.FinTM 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.FinTM 0 rhs
            | .const ``Turing.Cfg _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.Cfg 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.Cfg 0 rhs
            | .const ``Turing.MultiTapeTM _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.MultiTapeTM 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.MultiTapeTM 0 rhs
            | .const ``Turing.Action _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.Action 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.Action 0 rhs
            | _ => pure ()
            match ← solve lhs rhs with
            | none => pure none
            | some (type, value) =>
              pure (some (← mkForallFVars xs type, ← mkLambdaFVars xs value))
      match pair with
      | none => pure ()
      | some (type, value) =>
        let declName := Name.mkSimple s!"F6FirstHeaderRflControl_{index}_{mode}"
        liftCoreM <| addDecl (.thmDecl {
          name := declName, levelParams := di.levelParams, type := type, value := value })

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg

/-! Kernel-checked direct Eq.refl controls. Pointwise goals project a data field
for structure-valued definitions; abstracted goals compare the whole defining function.
Every failure has its own definition/mode identifier; no failed proof is admitted. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
elab "#f6_first_header_controls" : command => do
  let names : List Name := [`Turing.MultiTapeTM.step,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
    `Turing.Cfg.init,
    `Turing.Action.apply,
    `Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol,
    `Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
    `Turing.moveInputPos,
    `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime,
    `Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime,
    `Turing.FinTM.Computes,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape,
    `Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead,
    `Turing.FinTM.controlAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.leftAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.rightAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.emitAction,
    `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape,
    `Turing.Cfg.mapState,
    `Turing.seamCompTM,
    `Turing.embedEmitTM,
    `Turing.embedEmitRetTM,
    `Turing.embedEmitCfg,
    `Turing.rulerHostCfg,
    `Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg,
    `Turing.startupLoopTM,
    `Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM,
    `Turing.pairEncode,
    `Turing.tableBitsK,
    `Turing.unaryFin,
    `Turing.tapeAction,
    `Turing.headerRulerTM,
    `Turing.headerScanTM]
  let mut index := 0
  for n in names do
    let some (.defnInfo di) := (← getEnv).find? n | throwError "not a definition {n}"
    for mode in ["point", "abstract"] do
      index := index + 1
      let pair ← liftTermElabM do
        let levels := di.levelParams.map Level.param
        let head := mkConst n levels
        let solve := fun (lhs rhs : Expr) => do
          let goalType ← mkEq lhs rhs
          let goal ← mkFreshExprSyntheticOpaqueMVar goalType
          try
            goal.mvarId!.refl
            let value ← instantiateMVars goal
            pure (some (goalType, value))
          catch ex =>
            logInfo m!"CONTROL|{n}|{mode}|FAIL"
            logError m!"RFL_CONTROL|{n}|{mode}|{ex.toMessageData}"
            pure none
        if mode == "abstract" then
          solve head di.value
        else
          forallTelescope di.type fun xs resultType => do
            let mut lhs := mkAppN head xs
            let mut rhs := (mkAppN di.value xs).headBeta
            -- Projection goals are distinct from the complete equation even for nullary data.
            match resultType.getAppFn with
            | .const ``Turing.FinTM _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.FinTM 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.FinTM 0 rhs
            | .const ``Turing.Cfg _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.Cfg 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.Cfg 0 rhs
            | .const ``Turing.MultiTapeTM _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.MultiTapeTM 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.MultiTapeTM 0 rhs
            | .const ``Turing.Action _ =>
              lhs := mkProj ``Turing.Action 0 lhs
              rhs := mkProj ``Turing.Action 0 rhs
            | _ => pure ()
            match ← solve lhs rhs with
            | none => pure none
            | some (type, value) =>
              pure (some (← mkForallFVars xs type, ← mkLambdaFVars xs value))
      match pair with
      | none => pure ()
      | some (type, value) =>
        let declName := Name.mkSimple s!"F6FirstHeaderRflControl_{index}_{mode}"
        liftCoreM <| addDecl (.thmDecl {
          name := declName, levelParams := di.levelParams, type := type, value := value })
        logInfo m!"CONTROL|{n}|{mode}|PASS|kernelChecked={declName}"

#f6_first_header_controls

namespace F6FirstHeaderPreship
open Turing

/-- The fixed first physical header row, from its real initial configuration, reads any
doubled header and delimiter, rewinds the last ruler to zero, and preserves every bank tape.
The exact elapsed time and strict return cut are those of `headerRulerTM_run`.

**Proof sketch.** Override the public rows' initial controls locally. The public restart
identity matches the header row's actual initialization with the scan's real initialization.
Instantiate the header-ruler contract at offset zero and blank initial tapes, normalize its
endpoint through initialization field equations, and read all endpoint fields. Public output
monotonicity and the generic time-space bound give silence and a header-linear envelope. -/
private theorem first_header_component (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase), H.q₀ = Sum.inl 0 ∧
      ∀ u v : List Bool,
        let z := pairEncode u v
        let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2
        let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
        let hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2 := by
          have hz := length_pairEncode u v
          dsimp only [z, ℓ]
          omega

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace F6FirstHeaderPreship
open Turing

/-- The fixed first physical header row, from its real initial configuration, reads any
doubled header and delimiter, rewinds the last ruler to zero, and preserves every bank tape.
The exact elapsed time and strict return cut are those of `headerRulerTM_run`.

**Proof sketch.** Override the public rows' initial controls locally. The public restart
identity matches the header row's actual initialization with the scan's real initialization.
Instantiate the header-ruler contract at offset zero and blank initial tapes, normalize its
endpoint through initialization field equations, and read all endpoint fields. Public output
monotonicity and the generic time-space bound give silence and a header-linear envelope. -/
private theorem first_header_component (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase), H.q₀ = Sum.inl 0 ∧
      ∀ u v : List Bool,
        let z := pairEncode u v
        let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2
        let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
        let hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2 := by
          have hz := length_pairEncode u v
          dsimp only [z, ℓ]
          omega
        let e : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) z :=
          ⟨some (Sum.inr .done), ⟨ℓ + 1, hlen⟩,
            Function.update (fun _ _ => none) i (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)),
            fun _ => 0, []⟩
        H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e ∧
        (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).inputPos.val = ℓ + 1 ∧
        (∀ a : ℤ, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapes i a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) a) ∧
        (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapePos i = 0 ∧
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 4), j ≠ i →
          (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapes j = (H.initCfg z).workTapes j ∧
          (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapePos j = (H.initCfg z).workTapePos j) ∧
        (∀ t ≤ 2 * ℓ + 3, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t).output = []) ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * ℓ + 3, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done)) ∧
        (∀ t ≤ 2 * ℓ + 3, H.spaceUsed (H.initCfg z) t ≤ (K + 4) * (2 * ℓ + 4)) := by
  classical
  let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
  let S : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4) := { headerScanTM i with q₀ := 0 }
  let H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) :=
    { headerRulerTM i with q₀ := Sum.inl 0 }
  refine ⟨H, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro u v z ℓ index hlen e
  let d := S.initCfg z
  have hd : d = Cfg.init (0 : Fin 4) z :=
    MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀ (headerScanTM i) 0 z
  have hpos : d.inputPos.val = 1 + 0 := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_inputPos]; rfl
  have hstate : d.state = some 0 := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_state]
  have hblank (a : ℤ) : d.workTapes i a = none := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapes]
  have hinit : H.initCfg z = d.mapState Sum.inl :=
    MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState S H Sum.inl rfl z
  obtain ⟨hrow, hcut⟩ := headerRulerTM_run i d 0 hpos hstate u v
    (by rw [List.drop_zero]) hblank
  have transport (t : ℕ) : H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t =
      (headerRulerTM i).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t := by
    calc H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t = H.runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t :=
        congrArg (fun c => H.runFrom c t) hinit
      _ = (headerRulerTM i).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t :=
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀ (headerRulerTM i) (Sum.inl 0) _ t
  have hw : d.workTapes = fun _ _ => none := by
    funext j a
    rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapes]
  have hh : d.workTapePos = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext j
    rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  have ho : d.output = [] := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_output]
  have hip : d.inputPos.val = 1 := by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hpos
  have hend : H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e := by
    rw [transport]
    simpa only [e, ℓ, hw, hh, ho, hip, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, Nat.one_add] using hrow
  refine ⟨hend, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hend]
  · intro a
    rw [hend]
    exact congrFun (Function.update_self index (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true))
      (fun _ _ => none)) a
  · rw [hend]
  · intro j hj
    rw [hend, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀]
    constructor
    · funext a
      simp only [e, Function.update_of_ne hj, Cfg.init_workTapes]
    · rw [Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  · intro t ht
    have hp := (H.output_prefix (H.initCfg z) ht).length_le
    rw [hend, List.length_nil] at hp
    exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hp)
  · intro t ht
    rw [transport]
    exact hcut t ht
  · intro t ht
    exact (H.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ (H.initCfg z) t).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (K + 4) (by omega))

end F6FirstHeaderPreship
#print axioms F6FirstHeaderPreship.first_header_component

    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n

    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do

      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

namespace F6FirstHeaderPreship
open Turing

/-- The fixed first physical header row, from its real initial configuration, reads any
doubled header and delimiter, rewinds the last ruler to zero, and preserves every bank tape.
The exact elapsed time and strict return cut are those of `headerRulerTM_run`.

**Proof sketch.** Override the public rows' initial controls locally. The public restart
identity matches the header row's actual initialization with the scan's real initialization.
Instantiate the header-ruler contract at offset zero and blank initial tapes, normalize its
endpoint through initialization field equations, and read all endpoint fields. Public output
monotonicity and the generic time-space bound give silence and a header-linear envelope. -/
private theorem first_header_component (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase), H.q₀ = Sum.inl 0 ∧
      ∀ u v : List Bool,
        let z := pairEncode u v
        let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2
        let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
        let hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2 := by
          have hz := length_pairEncode u v
          dsimp only [z, ℓ]
          omega
        let e : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) z :=
          ⟨some (Sum.inr .done), ⟨ℓ + 1, hlen⟩,
            Function.update (fun _ _ => none) i (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)),
            fun _ => 0, []⟩
        H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e ∧
        (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).inputPos.val = ℓ + 1 ∧
        (∀ a : ℤ, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapes i a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) a) ∧
        (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapePos i = 0 ∧
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 4), j ≠ i →
          (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapes j = (H.initCfg z).workTapes j ∧
          (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapePos j = (H.initCfg z).workTapePos j) ∧
        (∀ t ≤ 2 * ℓ + 3, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t).output = []) ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * ℓ + 3, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done)) ∧
        (∀ t ≤ 2 * ℓ + 3, H.spaceUsed (H.initCfg z) t ≤ (K + 4) * (2 * ℓ + 4)) := by
  classical
  let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
  let S : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4) := { headerScanTM i with q₀ := 0 }
  let H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) :=
    { headerRulerTM i with q₀ := Sum.inl 0 }
  refine ⟨H, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro u v z ℓ index hlen e
  let d := S.initCfg z
  have hd : d = Cfg.init (0 : Fin 4) z :=
    MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀ (headerScanTM i) 0 z
  have hpos : d.inputPos.val = 1 + 0 := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_inputPos]; rfl
  have hstate : d.state = some 0 := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_state]
  have hblank (a : ℤ) : d.workTapes i a = none := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapes]
  have hinit : H.initCfg z = d.mapState Sum.inl :=
    MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState S H Sum.inl rfl z
  obtain ⟨hrow, hcut⟩ := headerRulerTM_run i d 0 hpos hstate u v
    (by exact List.drop_zero z) hblank
  have transport (t : ℕ) : H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t =
      (headerRulerTM i).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t := by
    rw [hinit]
    exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀ (headerRulerTM i) (Sum.inl 0) _ t
  have hend : H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e := by
    rw [transport]
    simpa only [hd, Cfg.init_inputPos, Cfg.init_workTapes, Cfg.init_workTapePos,
      Cfg.init_output, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, Nat.one_add] using hrow
  refine ⟨hend, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hend]
  · intro a
    rw [hend]
    exact congrFun (Function.update_self index (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true))
      (fun _ _ => none)) a
  · rw [hend]
  · intro j hj
    rw [hend, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀]
    constructor
    · simpa only [e, Function.update_of_ne hj, Cfg.init_workTapes]
    · rw [Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  · intro t ht
    have hp := (H.output_prefix (H.initCfg z) ht).length_le
    rw [hend, List.length_nil] at hp
    exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hp)
  · intro t ht
    rw [transport]
    exact hcut t ht
  · intro t ht
    exact (H.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ (H.initCfg z) t).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (K + 4) (by omega))

end F6FirstHeaderPreship
#print axioms F6FirstHeaderPreship.first_header_component

/-! Read-only compiled inventory of the four proposed proof roots and their descendants.
Imported theorem proof values are not traversed. Existing same-home legacy helpers remain
outside the changed proof scope. Root types and compiled values are both inspected. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List String := ["first_header_component"]
  let kind := fun (ci : ConstantInfo) => match ci with
    | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom" | .defnInfo _ => "definition" | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
    | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient" | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
    | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    match n with
    | .str _ base => if wanted.contains base then roots := roots.push n
    | _ => pure ()
  if roots.size != wanted.length then
    throwError "Root count mismatch: {roots.size} for {wanted.length} source roots"
  for root in roots.qsort Name.lt do
    logInfo m!"ROOT|{root}|private={isPrivateName root}"
  let mut selected : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    if roots.any (fun r => r.isPrefixOf n) then selected := selected.push n
  for n in selected.qsort Name.lt do
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "selected constant missing {n}"
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
    logInfo m!"PROOFAX|{n}|kind={kind ci}|{(axs.qsort Name.lt).toList}"
    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do
      if seen.contains c then continue
      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with
      | some j, some (.defnInfo di) =>
        let owner := env.header.moduleNames[j.toNat]!
        if (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf owner then
          let hint := match di.hints with
            | .abbrev => "abbrev" | .opaque => "opaque" | .regular _ => "regular"
          logInfo m!"FOREIGNDEF|{n}|{c}|{owner}|hints={hint}"
      | none, some (.defnInfo _) =>
        logInfo m!"HOMEDEF|{n}|{c}"
      | _, _ => pure ()

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.MultiTapeTM.step Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.Cfg.init Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols Turing.moveInputPos Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime Turing.FinTM.Computes Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead Turing.FinTM.controlAction Turing.FinTM.leftAction Turing.FinTM.rightAction Turing.FinTM.emitAction Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.Cfg.mapState Turing.seamCompTM Turing.embedEmitTM Turing.embedEmitRetTM Turing.embedEmitCfg Turing.rulerHostCfg Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg Turing.startupLoopTM Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM Turing.pairEncode Turing.tableBitsK Turing.unaryFin Turing.tapeAction Turing.headerRulerTM Turing.headerScanTM

namespace F6FirstHeaderPreship
open Turing

/-- The fixed first physical header row, from its real initial configuration, reads any
doubled header and delimiter, rewinds the last ruler to zero, and preserves every bank tape.
The exact elapsed time and strict return cut are those of `headerRulerTM_run`.

**Proof sketch.** Override the public rows' initial controls locally. The public restart
identity matches the header row's actual initialization with the scan's real initialization.
Instantiate the header-ruler contract at offset zero and blank initial tapes, normalize its
endpoint through initialization field equations, and read all endpoint fields. Public output
monotonicity and the generic time-space bound give silence and a header-linear envelope. -/
private theorem first_header_component (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase), H.q₀ = Sum.inl 0 ∧
      ∀ u v : List Bool,
        let z := pairEncode u v
        let ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2
        let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
        let hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2 := by
          have hz := length_pairEncode u v
          dsimp only [z, ℓ]
          omega
        let e : Cfg (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) z :=
          ⟨some (Sum.inr .done), ⟨ℓ + 1, hlen⟩,
            Function.update (fun _ _ => none) i (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)),
            fun _ => 0, []⟩
        H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e ∧
        (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).inputPos.val = ℓ + 1 ∧
        (∀ a : ℤ, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapes i a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) a) ∧
        (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapePos i = 0 ∧
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 4), j ≠ i →
          (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapes j = (H.initCfg z).workTapes j ∧
          (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3)).workTapePos j = (H.initCfg z).workTapePos j) ∧
        (∀ t ≤ 2 * ℓ + 3, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t).output = []) ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * ℓ + 3, (H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done)) ∧
        (∀ t ≤ 2 * ℓ + 3, H.spaceUsed (H.initCfg z) t ≤ (K + 4) * (2 * ℓ + 4)) := by
  classical
  let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
  let S : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4) := { headerScanTM i with q₀ := 0 }
  let H : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool (Fin 4 ⊕ RewindPhase) :=
    { headerRulerTM i with q₀ := Sum.inl 0 }
  refine ⟨H, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro u v z ℓ index hlen e
  let d := S.initCfg z
  have hd : d = Cfg.init (0 : Fin 4) z :=
    MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀ (headerScanTM i) 0 z
  have hpos : d.inputPos.val = 1 + 0 := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_inputPos]; rfl
  have hstate : d.state = some 0 := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_state]
  have hblank (a : ℤ) : d.workTapes i a = none := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapes]
  have hinit : H.initCfg z = d.mapState Sum.inl :=
    MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState S H Sum.inl rfl z
  obtain ⟨hrow, hcut⟩ := headerRulerTM_run i d 0 hpos hstate u v
    (by rw [List.drop_zero]) hblank
  have transport (t : ℕ) : H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t =
      (headerRulerTM i).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t := by
    calc H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) t = H.runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t :=
        congrArg (fun c => H.runFrom c t) hinit
      _ = (headerRulerTM i).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) t :=
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀ (headerRulerTM i) (Sum.inl 0) _ t
  have hw : d.workTapes = fun _ _ => none := by
    funext j a
    rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapes]
  have hh : d.workTapePos = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext j
    rw [hd, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  have ho : d.output = [] := by rw [hd, Cfg.init_output]
  have hip : d.inputPos.val = 1 := by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hpos
  have hend : H.runFrom (H.initCfg z) (2 * ℓ + 3) = e := by
    rw [transport]
    simpa only [e, ℓ, hw, hh, ho, hip, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, Nat.one_add] using hrow
  refine ⟨hend, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hend]
  · intro a
    rw [hend]
    exact congrFun (Function.update_self index (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true))
      (fun _ _ => none)) a
  · rw [hend]
  · intro j hj
    rw [hend, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀]
    constructor
    · funext a
      simp only [e, Function.update_of_ne hj, Cfg.init_workTapes]
    · rw [Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  · intro t ht
    have hp := (H.output_prefix (H.initCfg z) ht).length_le
    rw [hend, List.length_nil] at hp
    exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hp)
  · intro t ht
    rw [transport]
    exact hcut t ht
  · intro t ht
    exact (H.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ (H.initCfg z) t).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (K + 4) (by omega))

end F6FirstHeaderPreship
#print axioms F6FirstHeaderPreship.first_header_component

/-! Read-only compiled inventory of the single proposed proof root and their descendants.
Imported theorem proof values are not traversed. Existing same-home legacy helpers remain
outside the changed proof scope. Root types and compiled values are both inspected. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List String := ["first_header_component"]
  let kind := fun (ci : ConstantInfo) => match ci with
    | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom" | .defnInfo _ => "definition" | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
    | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient" | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
    | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    match n with
    | .str _ base => if wanted.contains base then roots := roots.push n
    | _ => pure ()
  if roots.size != wanted.length then
    throwError "Root count mismatch: {roots.size} for {wanted.length} source roots"
  for root in roots.qsort Name.lt do
    logInfo m!"ROOT|{root}|private={isPrivateName root}"
  let mut selected : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    if roots.any (fun r => r.isPrefixOf n) then selected := selected.push n
  for n in selected.qsort Name.lt do
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "selected constant missing {n}"
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
    logInfo m!"PROOFAX|{n}|kind={kind ci}|{(axs.qsort Name.lt).toList}"
    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do
      if seen.contains c then continue
      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with
      | some j, some (.defnInfo di) =>
        let owner := env.header.moduleNames[j.toNat]!
        if (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf owner then
          let hint := match di.hints with
            | .abbrev => "abbrev" | .opaque => "opaque" | .regular _ => "regular"
          logInfo m!"FOREIGNDEF|{n}|{c}|{owner}|hints={hint}"
      | none, some (.defnInfo _) =>
        logInfo m!"HOMEDEF|{n}|{c}"
      | _, _ => pure ()

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/first-header-preship-v3/README.md =====

# First physical header and rewind: bounded pre-ship PASS

**DRAFT — not ready to dispatch.** This is an inert check of the first physical header component,
not an F6 fill, complete prefix, universal-machine construction or target proof. No source,
admission, API, import, Git state, shared snapshot or cache was changed. `space_universal` remains
untouched. No hypothesis about an unfinished prefix or an assumed ruler presentation is used.

The authoritative inputs are **`First-header-native-v3.lean.txt`** and
**`First-header-sealed-v3.lean.txt`**. Both exit **0**, with **0 errors and 0 warnings**.

| Final input | SHA-256 | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Native v3 | `78600a2e3f646d2ddc65b93b91477703ace826c6ddae1b887c1667ff6aed613f` | 2.19 s |
| Sealed v3 | `dfd79643d87841ddeb7bba45a9f996dbff99788a0097afe31696973605ca45ea` | 2.21 s |

## Actual fixed component and result

For each **fixed** `K`, before either input word is quantified, the probe chooses

```lean
let i : Fin (K + 4) := Fin.last (K + 3)
let H := { headerRulerTM i with q₀ := Sum.inl 0 }
```

Thus the physical bank has **K+4 tapes**, with the ruler at physical index **K+3**. The row's
transition table is retained; its explicit local initial-state override avoids reading the
opaque row's initial control. A local overridden `headerScanTM` supplies the real scan initial
configuration used by the public restart identity, not a second controller or host.

For **every** `u,v : List Bool`, set `z = pairEncode u v` and `ℓ = 2*|u|+2`. The published
`pairEncode_eq` identifies this input as
`(u.flatMap fun b => [b,b]) ++ [false,true] ++ v`: doubled header, delimiter, untouched suffix.
Starting from the actual **`H.initCfg z`**, the theorem proves:

- At exactly **`2*ℓ+3 = 4*|u|+7`** steps, the full configuration is the explicit endpoint at
  live state `Sum.inr RewindPhase.done`, input position **`ℓ+1`**, ruler contents
  `bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)` from origin zero, every head zero, every other tape blank,
  and output `[]`.
- It separately reads the input position, every ruler cell and the ruler head, and proves
  equality of each other tape and head with **the actual initial configuration's** corresponding
  field. Blank ruler initialization is derived from `Cfg.init_workTapes`, not assumed.
- The endpoint label is **never reached earlier**, at every `t < 2*ℓ+3`.
- Output is `[]` for **all** `t ≤ 2*ℓ+3`.
- Actual accumulated space satisfies
  `H.spaceUsed (H.initCfg z) t ≤ (K+4)*(2*ℓ+4)` for every `t ≤ 2*ℓ+3`.

The time is taken directly from **`headerRulerTM_run`**, not from an estimated route polynomial.
The final space envelope is the public generic `spaceUsed_le_mul_succ` at that actual time.
It is a bound for this row only, not a bound for the whole F6 prefix.

## Published API chain

`UniversalParts.lean:795` supplies `headerRulerTM_run`, including the exact endpoint and strict
first-return cut. Its offset is instantiated at **p=0**. The inputs to that contract are discharged
from the real initialization using `MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀` and the five `Cfg.init_*`
readers. `MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq_mapState` matches `H.initCfg z` with the scan initialization's
state relabelling; `runFrom_with_q₀` transports the actual row run. No body of either row,
`Cfg.init`, `initCfg`, `mapState` or `runFrom` is unfolded by the component proof.

The pointwise tape/head initialization equations are lifted by function extensionality to the
concrete initial field vectors before normalizing the published endpoint. `output_prefix` and
the empty final output establish silence; `spaceUsed_le_mul_succ` establishes the envelope.
The probe has no external run, input-position, blank-tape, presentation, endpoint or cut premise.
Its universal `u,v` quantifiers include empty headers and suffixes; `ℓ≥2` follows from its actual
definition. No malformed-code restriction or payload copy is introduced.

## Rule 10 and controls

The guard precedes the theorem's **docstring and complete header**. It seals **34 ordinary
definitions**, including model14/Simulation5, state maps, both header rows, the pairing, and the
previous bounded layout component's conservative operational superset. The default simp
definitions `Action.apply`, `Cfg.init` and `MultiTapeTM.initCfg` are disabled. Removing exactly
the recorded guard recovers the native v3 bytes.

The fresh compiled inventory examines the theorem's type/value and its **two compiled
descendants**. All three have only subsets of `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}`. Their
nine direct foreign ordinary definitions are all guarded; seven direct field projections are
classified as reducible abbreviations. The conservative 34 guards are not claimed to be 34
direct dependencies. Imported theorem proofs are consumed opaquely rather than re-audited.

Fresh controls cover **all 34 definitions**, independently in pointwise and abstract-function
modes. All **68** unsealed controls pass and create kernel-checked theorem constants. The sealed
counterparts exit1 with **exactly 68** expected, individually identified `rfl` failures. The checker
verifies identities/multiplicities and rejects synthetic missing, duplicate-replacing-missing,
unexpected-outcome and exit0 evidence. No unsafe reducibility or admitted failed control is used.

Manual inspection of all explicit `rw`/`simp`/`simpa`/`dsimp` arguments in v3 found only local
definitions/hypotheses or published equations and theorems. In particular local `e,ℓ` are
expanded; none of the nine foreign ordinary definitions is named as an unfolding argument.
`rfl` for the chosen initial control reads only the locally overridden record, while the foreign
header rows stay opaque. See `compiled-inventory.json`, `control-check.json`, and `verification.json`.

## Context, attempts and limits

The supplied API worktree head is `1160c18f03fd318f0dec25738790935fa61379d4`; no Git command was
run to attest that supplied identifier or current merge status. All runs used only the managed
plain wrapper against **wt-natbits / read-only complete oleans-mra2**, sequentially at local
budget three under machine budget five. `context.json` captures eleven source/compiled pins;
they remain unchanged. Only Hierarchy is imported. All inputs are `.lean.txt` here and were copied
to unique `/private/tmp` paths for elaboration; no compiled output was requested.

All **seven** attempts and raw receipts/logs are retained. Sealed v1 had two local proof-script
errors (`drop_zero`'s implicit argument and a pointwise initialization field used as a function
equality). Native v2 had two errors and sealed v2 one: the endpoint needed explicit whole-function
initial field equalities, while native reduction made a transport `rw` close before its next
tactic. V3 supplies those concrete field equalities and uses the public transport as an explicit
calculation. Failed-run `sorryAx` diagnostics are not evidence about v3; neither final output
contains `sorryAx`. The sealed-control failure is intentional and exact-checked.

**No concrete reader/type gap was found for this bounded component.** This does not establish
API sufficiency for the remaining route. The actual outer seam, hosted startup and return,
second scan/correction/rewind, full-bank final loop and complete prefix ledger remain outside
this task; see `REMAINING.md`. No screen, replay, source edit, new host/API, debt acknowledgment,
dispatch readiness or gate clearance is claimed.

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/first-header-preship-v3/check-controls.py =====

```
"""Check exact per-definition control multiplicities and exercise rejection cases."""
from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
names = (out / 'control-definitions.txt').read_text().splitlines()
expected = {(name, mode) for name in names for mode in ('point', 'abstract')}


def check(positive, negative, positive_receipt, negative_receipt):
    for text, wanted in ((positive, 'PASS'), (negative, 'FAIL')):
        rows = [line.split('|') for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('CONTROL|')]
        counts = Counter((row[1], row[2]) for row in rows)
        assert counts == Counter({key: 1 for key in expected}), 'control multiplicity mismatch'
        assert all(row[3] == wanted for row in rows), 'unexpected control outcome'
        if wanted == 'PASS':
            assert all(len(row) == 5 and row[4].startswith('kernelChecked=') for row in rows)
            assert len({row[4] for row in rows}) == len(expected), 'duplicate kernel proof name'
    error_ids = Counter(re.findall(r'RFL_CONTROL\|([^|\n]+)\|(point|abstract)\|', negative))
    assert error_ids == Counter({key: 1 for key in expected}), 'diagnostic multiplicity mismatch'
    error_pattern = r'(?m)^.*:\d+:\d+: error(?:\([^)]*\))?:'
    assert len(re.findall(error_pattern, positive)) == 0
    assert len(re.findall(error_pattern, negative)) == len(expected)
    assert (positive_receipt['exit'], positive_receipt['errors']) == (0, 0)
    assert (negative_receipt['exit'], negative_receipt['errors']) == (1, len(expected))


positive = (out / 'Controls-unsealed-v1.out').read_text()
negative = (out / 'Controls-sealed-v1.out').read_text()
pr = json.loads((out / 'Controls-unsealed-v1-run.json').read_text())
nr = json.loads((out / 'Controls-sealed-v1-run.json').read_text())
check(positive, negative, pr, nr)
ids = re.findall(r'RFL_CONTROL\|[^|\n]+\|(?:point|abstract)\|', negative)
negative_cases = {}
cases = {
    'duplicate_diagnostic_identity_preserving_count':
        (negative.replace(ids[0], ids[1], 1), deepcopy(nr)),
    'missing_diagnostic_identity':
        (negative.replace(ids[0], 'REMOVED_DIAGNOSTIC|', 1), deepcopy(nr)),
    'unexpected_positive_outcome':
        (negative.replace('|point|FAIL', '|point|PASS', 1), deepcopy(nr)),
    'zero_negative_exit': (negative, {**nr, 'exit': 0}),
}
for name, (changed, receipt) in cases.items():
    try:
        check(positive, changed, pr, receipt)
    except AssertionError:
        negative_cases[name] = 'rejected'
    else:
        raise AssertionError('checker accepted invalid evidence: ' + name)
result = {
    'definitions': len(names),
    'pointwise_and_abstracted_pairs': len(expected),
    'positive_exit': pr['exit'],
    'negative_exit': nr['exit'],
    'negative_lean_diagnostics': nr['errors'],
    'all_exact_multiplicities_match': True,
    'checker_negative_cases': negative_cases,
}
(out / 'control-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
```

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/first-header-preship-v3/metadata-appendix-v3.lean.txt =====


/-! Read-only compiled inventory of the single proposed proof root and their descendants.
Imported theorem proof values are not traversed. Existing same-home legacy helpers remain
outside the changed proof scope. Root types and compiled values are both inspected. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List String := ["first_header_component"]
  let kind := fun (ci : ConstantInfo) => match ci with
    | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom" | .defnInfo _ => "definition" | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
    | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient" | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
    | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    match n with
    | .str _ base => if wanted.contains base then roots := roots.push n
    | _ => pure ()
  if roots.size != wanted.length then
    throwError "Root count mismatch: {roots.size} for {wanted.length} source roots"
  for root in roots.qsort Name.lt do
    logInfo m!"ROOT|{root}|private={isPrivateName root}"
  let mut selected : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    if roots.any (fun r => r.isPrefixOf n) then selected := selected.push n
  for n in selected.qsort Name.lt do
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "selected constant missing {n}"
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
    logInfo m!"PROOFAX|{n}|kind={kind ci}|{(axs.qsort Name.lt).toList}"
    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do
      if seen.contains c then continue
      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with
      | some j, some (.defnInfo di) =>
        let owner := env.header.moduleNames[j.toNat]!
        if (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf owner then
          let hint := match di.hints with
            | .abbrev => "abbrev" | .opaque => "opaque" | .regular _ => "regular"
          logInfo m!"FOREIGNDEF|{n}|{c}|{owner}|hints={hint}"
      | none, some (.defnInfo _) =>
        logInfo m!"HOMEDEF|{n}|{c}"
      | _, _ => pure ()

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/first-header-preship-v3/run-probe.py =====

```
"""One sequential plain managed elaboration; no compiled output or library edits."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=OUT.parents[4]
context=json.loads((OUT/'context.json').read_text())
name=sys.argv[1]
source=OUT/(name+'.lean.txt');log=OUT/(name+'.out');receipt=OUT/(name+'-run.json')
assert not log.exists() and not receipt.exists()
data=source.read_bytes();tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='tcslib-f6-first-header-',dir='/private/tmp'))
p=tmp/(name.replace('-','_')+'.lean');p.write_bytes(data)
command=['bash',str(ROOT/'devtools/seyoon/leanelab.sh'),context['worktree'],context['snapshot'],str(p)]
start=time.time();row=dict(command=command,start_utc=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(start,datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),local_slots=os.environ.get('TCSLIB_LEAN_SLOTS'),plain_managed=True,no_outer_lock=True)
(OUT/(name+'-request.json')).write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
log.write_bytes(r.stdout);text=r.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
row.update(exit=r.returncode,seconds=time.time()-start,errors=len(re.findall(r'^.*:\d+:\d+: error(?:\([^)]*\))?:',text,re.M)),output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest())
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(row,indent=2))
print('\n'.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if ' error' in line or 'depends on axioms' in line))
```

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/first-header-preship-v3/verify.py =====

```
"""Read-only checks of all retained attempts, final pins, controls and compiled inventory."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
context = json.loads((OUT / 'context.json').read_text())


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


attempts = []
for receipt in sorted(OUT.glob('*-run.json')):
    row = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
    name = receipt.name[:-len('-run.json')]
    source = (OUT / (name + '.lean.txt')).read_bytes()
    log = (OUT / (name + '.out')).read_bytes()
    assert sha(source) == row['input_sha256']
    assert sha(log) == row['output_sha256']
    assert Path(row['command'][-1]).read_bytes() == source
    assert row['command'][1].endswith('/devtools/seyoon/leanelab.sh')
    assert row['plain_managed'] and row['local_slots'] == '3'
    errors = len(re.findall(r'^.*:\d+:\d+: error(?:\([^)]*\))?:', log.decode(), re.M))
    assert errors == row['errors']
    attempts.append(dict(name=name, exit=row['exit'], errors=errors,
                         warnings=len(re.findall(r'^.*:\d+:\d+: warning:', log.decode(), re.M)),
                         seconds=row['seconds'], input_sha256=row['input_sha256'],
                         output_sha256=row['output_sha256']))
assert len(attempts) == 7
by_name = {row['name']: row for row in attempts}
for name in ['First-header-native-v3', 'First-header-sealed-v3']:
    assert (by_name[name]['exit'], by_name[name]['errors'], by_name[name]['warnings']) == (0, 0, 0)

native = (OUT / 'First-header-native-v3.lean.txt').read_text()
sealed = (OUT / 'First-header-sealed-v3.lean.txt').read_text()
guard = (OUT / 'guard.txt').read_text()
assert sealed.count(guard) == 1 and sealed.replace(guard, '', 1) == native
assert sealed.index(guard) < sealed.index('/--') < sealed.index('private theorem first_header_component')
definitions = (OUT / 'control-definitions.txt').read_text().splitlines()
assert len(definitions) == len(set(definitions)) == 34
assert definitions == guard.splitlines()[0].split('] ', 1)[1].split()
control = json.loads((OUT / 'control-check.json').read_text())
assert control['definitions'] == 34 and control['pointwise_and_abstracted_pairs'] == 68
assert control['positive_exit'] == 0 and control['negative_exit'] == 1
assert control['negative_lean_diagnostics'] == 68 and control['all_exact_multiplicities_match']
assert set(control['checker_negative_cases'].values()) == {'rejected'}

log = (OUT / 'First-header-sealed-v3.out').read_text()
axioms = []
for match in re.finditer(r'^PROOFAX\|([^|\n]+)\|kind=([^|\n]+)\|\[([^\]]*)\]', log, re.M):
    name, kind, raw = match.groups()
    ax = [x.strip() for x in raw.split(',') if x.strip()]
    assert set(ax) <= {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}
    axioms.append(dict(name=name, kind=kind, axioms=ax))
assert len(axioms) == 3 and all(row['kind'] == 'theorem' for row in axioms)
assert 'sorryAx' not in log
foreign = []
for line in log.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('FOREIGNDEF|'):
        _, root, name, owner, hints = line.split('|')
        foreign.append(dict(root=root, name=name, owner=owner, hints=hints.split('=', 1)[1]))
ordinary = sorted({row['name'] for row in foreign if row['hints'] == 'regular'})
abbreviations = sorted({row['name'] for row in foreign if row['hints'] == 'abbrev'})
assert len(ordinary) == 9 and set(ordinary) <= set(definitions)
(OUT / 'compiled-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(
    root_count=1, compiled_descendants=2, axioms=axioms,
    direct_foreign_references=foreign, direct_ordinary_definitions=ordinary,
    direct_abbreviations=abbreviations, all_direct_ordinary_guarded=True,
    scope='The actual first-header theorem type/value and all prefix-named compiled descendants. Imported theorem proof bodies are consumed opaquely, not recursively re-audited.'), indent=2) + '\n')

for rel, expected in context['sources'].items():
    assert sha((Path(context['worktree']) / rel).read_bytes()) == expected, rel
for rel, expected in context['compiled'].items():
    assert sha((Path(context['snapshot']) / rel.replace('.lean', '.olean')).read_bytes()) == expected, rel
summary = dict(status='Bounded first-header+rewind pre-ship component passed; no fill, complete prefix or dispatch readiness claim.',
    attempts=attempts, guard_definitions=34, controls_pairs=68,
    root_count=1, compiled_descendants=2, all_three_standard_axioms=True,
    source_and_snapshot_pins_unchanged=True, native_sealed_guard_removal_byte_identity=True,
    guard_before_docs_and_headers=True, default_simp_definitions_removed=[
        'Turing.Action.apply', 'Turing.Cfg.init', 'Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg'],
    final_native_sha256=sha(native.encode()), final_sealed_sha256=sha(sealed.encode()),
    tested_reader_or_type_gap=None,
    no_actual_source_git_snapshot_cache_screen_or_admission_changes=True)
(OUT / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in summary.items() if key != 'attempts'}, indent=2))
```
