      { d with
        state := some .done
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i ((ell1 : ℤ) + 1)} ∧
      (∀ t < ell1 + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, _⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate ell1 true) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, zero_add] using hw p)
  simpa only [List.length_replicate, hh, zero_add] using And.intro run cut

/-- A scanned ruler of total length N supplies the exact framed-rewind window, including its
left blank. The row itself consumes N+2 steps and preserves all unselected heads. -/
theorem final_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool RewindPhase z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .start) (hh : d.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (N + 2) =
      {d with state := some .done, workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i 0} ∧
      (∀ t < N + 2, ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ N + 2 → j ≠ i →
        ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, frame⟩ := rewindTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate N true) N
    (by rw [List.length_replicate]) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw p)
  refine ⟨?_, cut, fun j t ht hj => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hh, sub_self] using run
  · simpa only [if_neg hj] using frame j t ht

/-- Relabelling an actual second-scan endpoint supplies all final rewind entry fields, while
keeping its arbitrary installed bank and physical input/output unchanged. -/
theorem to_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : c.state = some 3) (hh : c.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    let r := c.mapState (fun _ => RewindPhase.start)
    r.state = some .start ∧ r.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, r.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) ∧
      r.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧ r.output = c.output := by
  intro r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun a => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hq, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hh
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]; exact hw a
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- Installed-bank fields follow from the actual public H2-F embedding contract. The source
one-tape model uses bank indices 0/1/2; arbitrary extra K tapes remain blank and stationary. -/
theorem installed_bank (K n : ℕ) {Q : Type} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) :
    let sigma : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let e := embedEmitCfg sigma (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    e.state = some entry ∧ e.inputPos.val = 1 ∧
      (∀ j, e.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin (K + 3)) (a : ℤ), e.workTapes j a =
        if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) a
        else if j.val = 2 then FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2)
        else none) := by
  intro sigma e
  have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) () entry M x
  dsimp only [e, sigma] at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_, fun j a => ?_⟩
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_state]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_output]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    change (if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
      else if j.val = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
      else fun _ => none) a = _
    split_ifs <;> rfl

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace F6PhaseInterfaces
open Turing
/-- The second scan extends an already nonblank ruler; its physical start presentation is an
explicit prefix OWN interface, not a supplied proof that the entire prefix reaches it.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the public scan contract and ruler-extension reader at the existing
nonblank length. Public field equations and integer arithmetic identify the common ruler origin
and the two endpoint heads; their update equations preserve every other bank field. -/
theorem second_scan {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + ell1) (hq : d.state = some 0)
    (hh : d.workTapePos i = (ell1 : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a)
    (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ell1 = pairEncode u v) :
    let ell2 := 2 * u.length + 2
    let ht : d.inputPos.val + ell2 < z.length + 2 := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hz
      rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
      dsimp only [ell2]
      omega
    let c := headerScanCfg i d 3 ell2 ht
    (headerScanTM i).runFrom d ell2 = c ∧
      (∀ t < ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 3) ∧
      c.inputPos.val = 1 + (ell1 + ell2) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = ((ell1 + ell2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (ell1 + ell2) true) a) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → c.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).output = d.output) := by
  intro ell2 ht c
  obtain ⟨run, cut, silent⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d ell1 hp hq u v hz
  refine ⟨run, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, silent⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos]
    change d.inputPos.val + ell2 = 1 + (ell1 + ell2)
    omega
  · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ell2) i = _
    rw [Function.update_self, hh, Nat.cast_add]
    dsimp only [ell2]
    omega
  · intro a
    have hpre (b : ℤ) : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (ell1 : ℤ) + b) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) b := by
      simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw b
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ell2 ht ell1 hpre a
    simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using h
  · intro j hj
    constructor
    · funext a
      rw [headerScanCfg_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

/-- The actual skip ends one past the first ruler. Its start presentation is a named prefix
OWN interface. The published framed row preserves every field except control and this head. -/
theorem skip_endpoint {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .run) (hh : d.workTapePos i = 0)
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) :
    (skipTM k i).runFrom d (ell1 + 1) =
      { d with
        state := some .done
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i ((ell1 : ℤ) + 1)} ∧
      (∀ t < ell1 + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, _⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate ell1 true) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, zero_add] using hw p)
  simpa only [List.length_replicate, hh, zero_add] using And.intro run cut

/-- A scanned ruler of total length N supplies the exact framed-rewind window, including its
left blank. The row itself consumes N+2 steps and preserves all unselected heads. -/
theorem final_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool RewindPhase z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .start) (hh : d.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (N + 2) =
      {d with state := some .done, workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i 0} ∧
      (∀ t < N + 2, ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ N + 2 → j ≠ i →
        ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, frame⟩ := rewindTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate N true) N
    (by rw [List.length_replicate]) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw p)
  refine ⟨?_, cut, fun j t ht hj => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hh, sub_self] using run
  · simpa only [if_neg hj] using frame j t ht

/-- Relabelling an actual second-scan endpoint supplies all final rewind entry fields, while
keeping its arbitrary installed bank and physical input/output unchanged. -/
theorem to_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : c.state = some 3) (hh : c.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    let r := c.mapState (fun _ => RewindPhase.start)
    r.state = some .start ∧ r.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, r.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) ∧
      r.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧ r.output = c.output := by
  intro r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun a => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hq, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hh
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]; exact hw a
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- Installed-bank fields follow from the actual public H2-F embedding contract. The source
one-tape model uses bank indices 0/1/2; arbitrary extra K tapes remain blank and stationary. -/
theorem installed_bank (K n : ℕ) {Q : Type} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) :
    let sigma : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let e := embedEmitCfg sigma (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    e.state = some entry ∧ e.inputPos.val = 1 ∧
      (∀ j, e.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin (K + 3)) (a : ℤ), e.workTapes j a =
        if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) a
        else if j.val = 2 then FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2)
        else none) := by
  intro sigma e
  have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) () entry M x
  dsimp only [e, sigma] at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_, fun j a => ?_⟩
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_state]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_output]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    change (if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
      else if j.val = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
      else fun _ => none) a = _
    split_ifs <;> rfl

/-- An elementary native correction leaf moves only the last work head left once.
The machine is fixed before the input/configuration; no payload is copied.

**Proof sketch.** Use the published tape-move step equation and the public zero/succ
run equations. The initial label is false and the fresh endpoint label is true. -/
theorem last_ruler_correction (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool Bool z), d.state = some false →
        C.runFrom d 1 = {d with
          state := some true
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
            (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1)} ∧
        (∀ u < 1, (C.runFrom d u).state ≠ some true) ∧
        (∀ ℓ : ℕ, d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ) + 1 →
          (C.runFrom d 1).workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ)) := by
  classical
  let C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool :=
    ⟨false, fun _ _ _ => tapeAction (Fin.last (K + 3)) 0 none (-1) true⟩
  refine ⟨C, rfl, fun z d hs => ?_⟩
  have hr : C.runFrom d 1 = {d with
      state := some true
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
        (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1)} := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    have hstep := step_of_tapeAction_move C d (Fin.last (K + 3)) 0 (-1) hs rfl
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero, SignType.coe_neg, SignType.coe_one, sub_eq_add_neg]
      using hstep
  refine ⟨hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
    subst u
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hs]
    exact fun h => Bool.noConfusion (Option.some.inj h)
  · intro ℓ hℓ
    rw [hr]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
      (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1) (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ)
    rw [Function.update_self, hℓ]
    omega

/-- Skip, then the fixed one-cell correction, yields a literal next-scan presentation.
The full prefix run, dispatches and global space ledger remain Claude OWN obligations.

**Proof sketch.** Specialize the framed skip equation, relabel its live endpoint for the
already checked correction leaf, and use its actual one-step result. Public state-map fields
show the next scan starts at zero while every tape, native head and output is preserved. -/
theorem skip_correction_connection (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ),
        d.state = some .run → d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = 0 →
        (∀ a, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 3)) a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) →
        let s := (skipTM (K + 4) (Fin.last (K + 3))).runFrom d (ell1 + 1)
        let e := s.mapState (fun _ => false)
        let f := (C.runFrom e 1).mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 4))
        f.state = some 0 ∧ f.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) ∧
          f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.output = d.output := by
  obtain ⟨C, q, correct⟩ := last_ruler_correction K
  refine ⟨C, q, ?_⟩
  intro z d ell1 hs hh hw s e f
  have skip := (skip_endpoint (Fin.last (K + 3)) d ell1 hs hh hw).1
  change s = _ at skip
  have es : e.state = some false := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_state, skip]
    rfl
  have eh : e.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) + 1 := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, skip]
    exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  obtain ⟨run, cut, head⟩ := correct z e es
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, run]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    exact head ell1 eh
  · funext j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, run]
    change e.workTapes j a = d.workTapes j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, run]
    change e.inputPos = d.inputPos
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, run]
    change e.output = d.output
    rw [Cfg.mapState_output, skip]

end F6PhaseInterfaces

/-! Read-only compiled inventory of the single proposed proof root and their descendants.
Imported theorem proof values are not traversed. Existing same-home legacy helpers remain
outside the changed proof scope. Root types and compiled values are both inspected. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List String := ["second_scan", "skip_endpoint", "final_rewind", "to_rewind", "installed_bank", "last_ruler_correction", "skip_correction_connection"]
  let kind := fun (ci : ConstantInfo) => match ci with
    | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom" | .defnInfo _ => "definition" | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
    | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient" | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
    | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    match n with
    | .str _ base => if wanted.contains base then roots := roots.push n
    | _ => pure ()
  if roots.size != wanted.length then
    throwError "Root count mismatch: {roots.size} for {wanted.length} source roots"
  for root in roots.qsort Name.lt do
    logInfo m!"ROOT|{root}|private={isPrivateName root}"
  let mut selected : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    if roots.any (fun r => r.isPrefixOf n) then selected := selected.push n
  for n in selected.qsort Name.lt do
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "selected constant missing {n}"
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
    logInfo m!"PROOFAX|{n}|kind={kind ci}|{(axs.qsort Name.lt).toList}"
    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do
      if seen.contains c then continue
      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with
      | some j, some (.defnInfo di) =>
        let owner := env.header.moduleNames[j.toNat]!
        if (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf owner then
          let hint := match di.hints with
            | .abbrev => "abbrev" | .opaque => "opaque" | .regular _ => "regular"
          logInfo m!"FOREIGNDEF|{n}|{c}|{owner}|hints={hint}"
      | none, some (.defnInfo _) =>
        logInfo m!"HOMEDEF|{n}|{c}"
      | _, _ => pure ()

set_option autoImplicit false
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.MultiTapeTM.step Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.Cfg.init Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols Turing.moveInputPos Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime Turing.FinTM.Computes Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead Turing.FinTM.controlAction Turing.FinTM.leftAction Turing.FinTM.rightAction Turing.FinTM.emitAction Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.Cfg.mapState Turing.seamCompTM Turing.embedEmitTM Turing.embedEmitRetTM Turing.embedEmitCfg Turing.rulerHostCfg Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg Turing.startupLoopTM Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM Turing.pairEncode Turing.tableBitsK Turing.unaryFin Turing.tapeAction Turing.headerRulerTM Turing.headerScanTM Turing.headerScanCfg Turing.skipTM Turing.rewindTM
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg

namespace F6PhaseInterfaces
open Turing
/-- The second scan extends an already nonblank ruler; its physical start presentation is an
explicit prefix OWN interface, not a supplied proof that the entire prefix reaches it.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the public scan contract and ruler-extension reader at the existing
nonblank length. Public field equations and integer arithmetic identify the common ruler origin
and the two endpoint heads; their update equations preserve every other bank field. -/
theorem second_scan {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + ell1) (hq : d.state = some 0)
    (hh : d.workTapePos i = (ell1 : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a)
    (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ell1 = pairEncode u v) :
    let ell2 := 2 * u.length + 2
    let ht : d.inputPos.val + ell2 < z.length + 2 := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hz
      rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
      dsimp only [ell2]
      omega
    let c := headerScanCfg i d 3 ell2 ht
    (headerScanTM i).runFrom d ell2 = c ∧
      (∀ t < ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 3) ∧
      c.inputPos.val = 1 + (ell1 + ell2) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = ((ell1 + ell2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (ell1 + ell2) true) a) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → c.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).output = d.output) := by
  intro ell2 ht c
  obtain ⟨run, cut, silent⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d ell1 hp hq u v hz
  refine ⟨run, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, silent⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos]
    change d.inputPos.val + ell2 = 1 + (ell1 + ell2)
    omega
  · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ell2) i = _
    rw [Function.update_self, hh, Nat.cast_add]
    dsimp only [ell2]
    omega
  · intro a
    have hpre (b : ℤ) : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (ell1 : ℤ) + b) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) b := by
      simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw b
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ell2 ht ell1 hpre a
    simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using h
  · intro j hj
    constructor
    · funext a
      rw [headerScanCfg_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

/-- The actual skip ends one past the first ruler. Its start presentation is a named prefix
OWN interface. The published framed row preserves every field except control and this head. -/
theorem skip_endpoint {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .run) (hh : d.workTapePos i = 0)
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) :
    (skipTM k i).runFrom d (ell1 + 1) =
      {d with state := some .done,
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i ((ell1 : ℤ) + 1)} ∧
      (∀ t < ell1 + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, _⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate ell1 true) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, zero_add] using hw p)
  simpa only [List.length_replicate, hh, zero_add] using And.intro run cut

/-- A scanned ruler of total length N supplies the exact framed-rewind window, including its
left blank. The row itself consumes N+2 steps and preserves all unselected heads. -/
theorem final_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool RewindPhase z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .start) (hh : d.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (N + 2) =
      {d with state := some .done, workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i 0} ∧
      (∀ t < N + 2, ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ N + 2 → j ≠ i →
        ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, frame⟩ := rewindTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate N true) N
    (by rw [List.length_replicate]) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw p)
  refine ⟨?_, cut, fun j t ht hj => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hh, sub_self] using run
  · simpa only [if_neg hj] using frame j t ht

/-- Relabelling an actual second-scan endpoint supplies all final rewind entry fields, while
keeping its arbitrary installed bank and physical input/output unchanged. -/
theorem to_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : c.state = some 3) (hh : c.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    let r := c.mapState (fun _ => RewindPhase.start)
    r.state = some .start ∧ r.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, r.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) ∧
      r.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧ r.output = c.output := by
  intro r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun a => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hq, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hh
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]; exact hw a
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- Installed-bank fields follow from the actual public H2-F embedding contract. The source
one-tape model uses bank indices 0/1/2; arbitrary extra K tapes remain blank and stationary. -/
theorem installed_bank (K n : ℕ) {Q : Type} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) :
    let sigma : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let e := embedEmitCfg sigma (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    e.state = some entry ∧ e.inputPos.val = 1 ∧
      (∀ j, e.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin (K + 3)) (a : ℤ), e.workTapes j a =
        if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) a
        else if j.val = 2 then FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2)
        else none) := by
  intro sigma e
  have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) () entry M x
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_, fun j a => ?_⟩
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_state]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_output]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    rfl

end F6PhaseInterfaces
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.second_scan
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.skip_endpoint
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.final_rewind
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.to_rewind
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.installed_bank

    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a)
    (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ell1 = pairEncode u v) :
    let ell2 := 2 * u.length + 2
    let ht : d.inputPos.val + ell2 < z.length + 2 := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hz
      rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
      dsimp only [ell2]
      omega
    let c := headerScanCfg i d 3 ell2 ht
    (headerScanTM i).runFrom d ell2 = c ∧
      (∀ t < ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 3) ∧
      c.inputPos.val = 1 + (ell1 + ell2) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = ((ell1 + ell2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (ell1 + ell2) true) a) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → c.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).output = d.output) := by
  intro ell2 ht c
  obtain ⟨run, cut, silent⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d ell1 hp hq u v hz
  refine ⟨run, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, silent⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos]
    change d.inputPos.val + ell2 = 1 + (ell1 + ell2)
    omega
  · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ell2) i = _
    rw [Function.update_self, hh, Nat.cast_add]
    dsimp only [ell2]
    omega
  · intro a
    have hpre (b : ℤ) : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (ell1 : ℤ) + b) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) b := by
      simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw b
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ell2 ht ell1 hpre a
    simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using h
  · intro j hj
    constructor
    · funext a
      rw [headerScanCfg_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

/-- The actual skip ends one past the first ruler. Its start presentation is a named prefix
OWN interface. The published framed row preserves every field except control and this head. -/
theorem skip_endpoint {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .run) (hh : d.workTapePos i = 0)
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) :
    (skipTM k i).runFrom d (ell1 + 1) =
      { d with
        state := some .done
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i ((ell1 : ℤ) + 1)} ∧
      (∀ t < ell1 + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, _⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate ell1 true) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, zero_add] using hw p)
  simpa only [List.length_replicate, hh, zero_add] using And.intro run cut

/-- A scanned ruler of total length N supplies the exact framed-rewind window, including its
left blank. The row itself consumes N+2 steps and preserves all unselected heads. -/
theorem final_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool RewindPhase z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .start) (hh : d.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (N + 2) =
      {d with state := some .done, workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i 0} ∧
      (∀ t < N + 2, ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ N + 2 → j ≠ i →
        ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, frame⟩ := rewindTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate N true) N
    (by rw [List.length_replicate]) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw p)
  refine ⟨?_, cut, fun j t ht hj => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hh, sub_self] using run
  · simpa only [if_neg hj] using frame j t ht

/-- Relabelling an actual second-scan endpoint supplies all final rewind entry fields, while
keeping its arbitrary installed bank and physical input/output unchanged. -/
theorem to_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : c.state = some 3) (hh : c.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    let r := c.mapState (fun _ => RewindPhase.start)
    r.state = some .start ∧ r.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, r.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) ∧
      r.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧ r.output = c.output := by
  intro r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun a => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hq, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hh
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]; exact hw a
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- Installed-bank fields follow from the actual public H2-F embedding contract. The source
one-tape model uses bank indices 0/1/2; arbitrary extra K tapes remain blank and stationary. -/
theorem installed_bank (K n : ℕ) {Q : Type} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) :
    let sigma : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let e := embedEmitCfg sigma (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    e.state = some entry ∧ e.inputPos.val = 1 ∧
      (∀ j, e.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin (K + 3)) (a : ℤ), e.workTapes j a =
        if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) a
        else if j.val = 2 then FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2)
        else none) := by
  intro sigma e
  have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) () entry M x
  dsimp only [e, sigma] at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_, fun j a => ?_⟩
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_state]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_output]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    rfl

end F6PhaseInterfaces

#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.skip_endpoint
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.final_rewind
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.to_rewind
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.installed_bank

/-- An elementary native correction leaf moves only the last work head left once.
The machine is fixed before the input/configuration; no payload is copied.

**Proof sketch.** Use the published tape-move step equation and the public zero/succ
run equations. The initial label is false and the fresh endpoint label is true. -/
theorem last_ruler_correction (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool Bool z), d.state = some false →
        C.runFrom d 1 = {d with
          state := some true
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))

        (∀ u < 1, (C.runFrom d u).state ≠ some true) ∧
        (∀ ℓ : ℕ, d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ) + 1 →
          (C.runFrom d 1).workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ)) := by
  classical
  let C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool :=
    ⟨false, fun _ _ _ => tapeAction (Fin.last (K + 3)) 0 none (-1) true⟩
  refine ⟨C, rfl, fun z d hs => ?_⟩
  have hr : C.runFrom d 1 = {d with
      state := some true
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
        (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1)} := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    have hstep := step_of_tapeAction_move C d (Fin.last (K + 3)) 0 (-1) hs rfl
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero, SignType.coe_neg, SignType.coe_one, sub_eq_add_neg]
      using hstep
  refine ⟨hr, ?_, ?_⟩

    have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
    subst u
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hs]
    exact fun h => Bool.noConfusion (Option.some.inj h)
  · intro ℓ hℓ
    rw [hr]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
      (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1) (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ)
    rw [Function.update_self, hℓ]
    omega

/-- Skip, then the fixed one-cell correction, yields a literal next-scan presentation.
The full prefix run, dispatches and global space ledger remain Claude OWN obligations.

**Proof sketch.** Specialize the framed skip equation, relabel its live endpoint for the
already checked correction leaf, and use its actual one-step result. Public state-map fields
show the next scan starts at zero while every tape, native head and output is preserved. -/
theorem skip_correction_connection (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ),
        d.state = some .run → d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = 0 →
        (∀ a, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 3)) a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) →
        let s := (skipTM (K + 4) (Fin.last (K + 3))).runFrom d (ell1 + 1)
        let e := s.mapState (fun _ => false)
        let f := (C.runFrom e 1).mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 4))
        f.state = some 0 ∧ f.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) ∧
          f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.output = d.output := by
  obtain ⟨C, q, correct⟩ := last_ruler_correction K
  refine ⟨C, q, ?_⟩
  intro z d ell1 hs hh hw s e f
  have skip := (skip_endpoint (Fin.last (K + 3)) d ell1 hs hh hw).1
  have es : e.state = some false := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_state, skip]
    rfl
  have eh : e.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) + 1 := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, skip]
    exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  obtain ⟨run, cut, head⟩ := correct z e es
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, run]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    exact head ell1 eh
  · funext j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, run]
    change e.workTapes j a = d.workTapes j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, run]
    change e.inputPos = d.inputPos
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, run]
    change e.output = d.output
    rw [Cfg.mapState_output, skip]

end F6PhaseInterfaces

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.MultiTapeTM.step Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.Cfg.init Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols Turing.moveInputPos Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime Turing.FinTM.Computes Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead Turing.FinTM.controlAction Turing.FinTM.leftAction Turing.FinTM.rightAction Turing.FinTM.emitAction Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.Cfg.mapState Turing.seamCompTM Turing.embedEmitTM Turing.embedEmitRetTM Turing.embedEmitCfg Turing.rulerHostCfg Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg Turing.startupLoopTM Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM Turing.pairEncode Turing.tableBitsK Turing.unaryFin Turing.tapeAction Turing.headerRulerTM Turing.headerScanTM Turing.headerScanCfg Turing.skipTM Turing.rewindTM
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg

namespace F6PhaseInterfaces
open Turing
/-- The second scan extends an already nonblank ruler; its physical start presentation is an
explicit prefix OWN interface, not a supplied proof that the entire prefix reaches it.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the public scan contract and ruler-extension reader at the existing
nonblank length. Public field equations and integer arithmetic identify the common ruler origin
and the two endpoint heads; their update equations preserve every other bank field. -/
theorem second_scan {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + ell1) (hq : d.state = some 0)
    (hh : d.workTapePos i = (ell1 : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a)
    (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ell1 = pairEncode u v) :
    let ell2 := 2 * u.length + 2
    let ht : d.inputPos.val + ell2 < z.length + 2 := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hz
      rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
      dsimp only [ell2]
      omega
    let c := headerScanCfg i d 3 ell2 ht
    (headerScanTM i).runFrom d ell2 = c ∧
      (∀ t < ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 3) ∧
      c.inputPos.val = 1 + (ell1 + ell2) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = ((ell1 + ell2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (ell1 + ell2) true) a) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → c.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).output = d.output) := by
  intro ell2 ht c
  obtain ⟨run, cut, silent⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d ell1 hp hq u v hz
  refine ⟨run, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, silent⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos]
    change d.inputPos.val + ell2 = 1 + (ell1 + ell2)
    omega
  · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ell2) i = _
    rw [Function.update_self, hh, Nat.cast_add]
    dsimp only [ell2]
    omega
  · intro a
    have hpre (b : ℤ) : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (ell1 : ℤ) + b) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) b := by
      simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw b
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ell2 ht ell1 hpre a
    simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using h
  · intro j hj
    constructor
    · funext a
      rw [headerScanCfg_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

/-- The actual skip ends one past the first ruler. Its start presentation is a named prefix
OWN interface. The published framed row preserves every field except control and this head. -/
theorem skip_endpoint {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .run) (hh : d.workTapePos i = 0)
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) :
    (skipTM k i).runFrom d (ell1 + 1) =
      { d with
        state := some .done
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i ((ell1 : ℤ) + 1)} ∧
      (∀ t < ell1 + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, _⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate ell1 true) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, zero_add] using hw p)
  simpa only [List.length_replicate, hh, zero_add] using And.intro run cut

/-- A scanned ruler of total length N supplies the exact framed-rewind window, including its
left blank. The row itself consumes N+2 steps and preserves all unselected heads. -/
theorem final_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool RewindPhase z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : d.state = some .start) (hh : d.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (N + 2) =
      {d with state := some .done, workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i 0} ∧
      (∀ t < N + 2, ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ N + 2 → j ≠ i →
        ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, frame⟩ := rewindTM_run_ofCfg i (List.replicate N true) N
    (by rw [List.length_replicate]) d hq
    (fun p _ _ => by simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw p)
  refine ⟨?_, cut, fun j t ht hj => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hh, sub_self] using run
  · simpa only [if_neg hj] using frame j t ht

/-- Relabelling an actual second-scan endpoint supplies all final rewind entry fields, while
keeping its arbitrary installed bank and physical input/output unchanged. -/
theorem to_rewind {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (N : ℕ)
    (hq : c.state = some 3) (hh : c.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) :
    let r := c.mapState (fun _ => RewindPhase.start)
    r.state = some .start ∧ r.workTapePos i = (N : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, r.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate N true) a) ∧
      r.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧ r.output = c.output := by
  intro r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun a => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hq, Option.map_some]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hh
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]; exact hw a
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- Installed-bank fields follow from the actual public H2-F embedding contract. The source
one-tape model uses bank indices 0/1/2; arbitrary extra K tapes remain blank and stationary. -/
theorem installed_bank (K n : ℕ) {Q : Type} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (x : List Bool) :
    let sigma : Fin 3 ↪ Fin (K + 3) := Fin.castLEEmb (by omega)
    let e := embedEmitCfg sigma (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
    e.state = some entry ∧ e.inputPos.val = 1 ∧
      (∀ j, e.workTapePos j = 0) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin (K + 3)) (a : ℤ), e.workTapes j a =
        if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr) a
        else if j.val = 2 then FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (a - 2)
        else none) := by
  intro sigma e
  have h := embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init (k := 1) (K := K) () entry M x
  dsimp only [e, sigma] at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_, fun j a => ?_⟩
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_state]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]; rfl
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_output]
  · rw [h, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    change (if j.val = 1 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
      else if j.val = 2 then fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)
      else fun _ => none) a = _
    split_ifs <;> rfl

/-- An elementary native correction leaf moves only the last work head left once.
The machine is fixed before the input/configuration; no payload is copied.

**Proof sketch.** Use the published tape-move step equation and the public zero/succ
run equations. The initial label is false and the fresh endpoint label is true. -/
theorem last_ruler_correction (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool Bool z), d.state = some false →
        C.runFrom d 1 = {d with
          state := some true
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
            (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1)} ∧
        (∀ u < 1, (C.runFrom d u).state ≠ some true) ∧
        (∀ ℓ : ℕ, d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ) + 1 →
          (C.runFrom d 1).workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ)) := by
  classical
  let C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool :=
    ⟨false, fun _ _ _ => tapeAction (Fin.last (K + 3)) 0 none (-1) true⟩
  refine ⟨C, rfl, fun z d hs => ?_⟩
  have hr : C.runFrom d 1 = {d with
      state := some true
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
        (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1)} := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    have hstep := step_of_tapeAction_move C d (Fin.last (K + 3)) 0 (-1) hs rfl
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero, SignType.coe_neg, SignType.coe_one, sub_eq_add_neg]
      using hstep
  refine ⟨hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
    subst u
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hs]
    exact fun h => Bool.noConfusion (Option.some.inj h)
  · intro ℓ hℓ
    rw [hr]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3))
      (d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) - 1) (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ℓ : ℤ)
    rw [Function.update_self, hℓ]
    omega

/-- Skip, then the fixed one-cell correction, yields a literal next-scan presentation.
The full prefix run, dispatches and global space ledger remain Claude OWN obligations.

**Proof sketch.** Specialize the framed skip equation, relabel its live endpoint for the
already checked correction leaf, and use its actual one-step result. Public state-map fields
show the next scan starts at zero while every tape, native head and output is preserved. -/
theorem skip_correction_connection (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ),
        d.state = some .run → d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = 0 →
        (∀ a, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 3)) a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) →
        let s := (skipTM (K + 4) (Fin.last (K + 3))).runFrom d (ell1 + 1)
        let e := s.mapState (fun _ => false)
        let f := (C.runFrom e 1).mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 4))
        f.state = some 0 ∧ f.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) ∧
          f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.output = d.output := by
  obtain ⟨C, q, correct⟩ := last_ruler_correction K
  refine ⟨C, q, ?_⟩
  intro z d ell1 hs hh hw s e f
  have skip := (skip_endpoint (Fin.last (K + 3)) d ell1 hs hh hw).1
  change s = _ at skip
  have es : e.state = some false := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_state, skip]
    rfl
  have eh : e.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) + 1 := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, skip]
    exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  obtain ⟨run, cut, head⟩ := correct z e es
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, run]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    exact head ell1 eh
  · funext j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, run]
    change e.workTapes j a = d.workTapes j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, run]
    change e.inputPos = d.inputPos
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, run]
    change e.output = d.output
    rw [Cfg.mapState_output, skip]

end F6PhaseInterfaces

#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.skip_endpoint
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.final_rewind

#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.installed_bank
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.last_ruler_correction
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.skip_correction_connection

/-! Read-only compiled inventory of the single proposed proof root and their descendants.
Imported theorem proof values are not traversed. Existing same-home legacy helpers remain
outside the changed proof scope. Root types and compiled values are both inspected. -/
open Lean Elab Command Meta in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List String := ["second_scan", "skip_endpoint", "final_rewind", "to_rewind", "installed_bank", "last_ruler_correction", "skip_correction_connection"]
  let kind := fun (ci : ConstantInfo) => match ci with
    | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom" | .defnInfo _ => "definition" | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
    | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient" | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
    | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    match n with
    | .str _ base => if wanted.contains base then roots := roots.push n
    | _ => pure ()
  if roots.size != wanted.length then
    throwError "Root count mismatch: {roots.size} for {wanted.length} source roots"
  for root in roots.qsort Name.lt do
    logInfo m!"ROOT|{root}|private={isPrivateName root}"
  let mut selected : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.toList do
    if roots.any (fun r => r.isPrefixOf n) then selected := selected.push n
  for n in selected.qsort Name.lt do
    let some ci := env.find? n | throwError "selected constant missing {n}"
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
    logInfo m!"PROOFAX|{n}|kind={kind ci}|{(axs.qsort Name.lt).toList}"
    let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ (ci.value?.map (·.getUsedConstants)).getD #[]
    let mut seen : Array Name := #[]
    for c in used do
      if seen.contains c then continue
      seen := seen.push c
      match env.getModuleIdxFor? c, env.find? c with
      | some j, some (.defnInfo di) =>
        let owner := env.header.moduleNames[j.toNat]!
        if (`TCSlib).isPrefixOf owner then
          let hint := match di.hints with
            | .abbrev => "abbrev" | .opaque => "opaque" | .regular _ => "regular"
          logInfo m!"FOREIGNDEF|{n}|{c}|{owner}|hints={hint}"
      | none, some (.defnInfo _) =>
        logInfo m!"HOMEDEF|{n}|{c}"
      | _, _ => pure ()

# F6 phase interfaces: bounded pre-ship PASS

**DRAFT — not ready to dispatch.** The seven inert phase-interface proofs pass natively and with
37 foreign definitions opaque, including complete headers and proof bodies. This checks the
prescribed public geometry and casts; it constructs no complete physical prefix, universal-machine
proof, global space ledger or target. No source, API, brief, Git, cache or shared snapshot changed.

Authoritative inputs are `Phases-v4.lean.txt` (sealed, exit0/errors0, 2.46 s) and its exact guard-
removed counterpart `Phases-native-v4.lean.txt` (exit0/errors0, 2.49 s). The machine context is the
read-only complete mra2 tree with wt-natbits; thirteen source/compiled pins remain unchanged.

## Checked connections and exact bridges

| Phase / connection | Actual bridge and premises discharged in the probe | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Skip first ruler | `skipTM_run_ofCfg`, at the physical last tape and word `true^ell1`; explicit OWN entry state `.run`, last head zero, exact ruler contents. The required `[0,ell1]` read window follows from that presentation. | Actual skip takes `ell1+1` steps, has its strict done cut, preserves all other fields, and leaves selected head at `ell1+1`. |
| One-cell correction and next scan type | Reuses the previous actual fixed correction leaf, rechecked under the expanded guard: its table is `tapeAction last 0 none (-1) true`; `step_of_tapeAction_move` proves its one-step run. `skip_correction_connection` feeds it the actual skip endpoint via public `Cfg.mapState_*` fields. | A correction machine chosen before input/configuration returns the selected head to `ell1` in one step. Relabelling to `Fin 4` gives scan control zero, with every tape, native input head and output equal to the pre-skip values. |
| Nonblank second scan | `headerScanTM_run` plus `headerScanCfg_ruler(m:=ell1)`. Explicit OWN native presentation is `inputPos.val=1+ell1`, `z.drop ell1=pairEncode u v`; the old ruler is `true^ell1` and its head is `ell1`. | With `ell2=2*|u|+2`, exactly `ell2` steps yield ruler `true^(ell1+ell2)` from the same origin, both endpoint coordinates `ell1+ell2` / native `1+ell1+ell2`, strict scan cut, silence and unchanged other banks/heads. The old ruler is nonblank; no blank-ruler hypothesis is substituted. |
| Scan to rewind | Public `Cfg.mapState_*` equations, from the scan's control three and derived head/ruler fields. | Rewind entry has actual `.start`, total ruler length/head `N=ell1+ell2`, unchanged physical input/output and the same tape contents. |
| Final framed rewind | `rewindTM_run_ofCfg` at `u=true^N`, `n=N`. Its `-1≤p<N` read window follows from the full ruler equation and head `N`; `n≤|u|` is `length_replicate`. | Actual rewind takes `N+2`, strictly reaches `.done`, resets the selected head to zero, preserves all tapes/input/output and every other head at every prefix. Its public selected-head frame is `[N-N-1,N]=[-1,N]`, including the left and right boundary cells; the probe exports the endpoint and all-other-head frame. |
| Installed bank and indices | `embedEmitCfg_forwardLoop_init(k:=1,K:=K)`, with the actual `Fin.castLEEmb : Fin3 ↪ Fin(K+3)`. Public map-state fields expose the already published literal bank layout. | The bank has entry control, native head one, all heads zero/output empty, table at value-one tape, unary state at value-two tape from cell two, all other tapes blank. The earlier last-ruler layout adds the physical last tape: K+4 total, ruler K+3. |

The input-position equation needed by the second scan follows by rewriting its unchanged native
input position with the explicit OWN starting equation. The ruler equation follows similarly from
the full tape equality returned by the skip/correction connection. Control relabellings use actual
public state-map fields, not hypothetical reader lemmas. All casts/length bounds in the full
second-scan header are checked, including empty headers (`ell2=2`) and arbitrary suffixes.

Component row times above include each row's own exit behavior. A `seamCompTM` boundary adds the
separate **one dispatch step** in its published run contract. No aggregate prefix time formula or
seam-composed prefix execution is claimed here; Claude must count actual boundaries in its fixed
assembly and prove the named prefix OWN run/cut/silence/space contracts. H5 handoff and the final
conditional seam are covered by the parent's separate v5/v7 work, not duplicated here.

## Rule 10, actual checks and failures

The final guard extends the previous34 with `headerScanCfg`, `skipTM`, `rewindTM`; three default
simp definitions are disabled. The actual compiled type/value inventory sees eighteen ordinary
foreign definitions, all guarded. Seven roots and six descendants have only subsets of
`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. Imported theorem proofs are consumed opaquely.
Every final rewriting/simplifier argument was inspected: only public equations/local equalities
and local lets `ell2,e,sigma` are expanded. Literal local record projections and Core reductions
supply no foreign-definition exception.

Fresh controls cover all37 definitions in pointwise and abstracted modes: **74 kernel-checked
unsealed successes**, then **74 expected sealed rfl failures**, exactly one per definition/mode.
A same-total duplicate/drop corruption is rejected. The controls use the reviewed maintainer
reflective harness; no delivered code is executed. Source/compiled pins and all inputs/logs/receipts
are retained in `context.json`, `compiled-inventory.json`, `controls-verification.json` and the
manifest. These are isolated managed-wrapper checks, not a replay.

Unsuccessful inputs remain intact: second-scanv1 had one local ell2 Nat/Int normalization goal;
Phasesv1 had a local record-layout syntax error plus five unexpanded embedding-let rewrites;
v2 had one if-valued literal-record application goal; v3 exposed three branch-local versions of
that goal and five local skip-let rewrite goals. V4 fixes the local projection/let forms without
changing any public interface. Failed scratch `sorryAx` prints are not passing evidence.

No missing public API or type seam was found for these scoped connections. The full physical
prefix execution, strict final cut/silence/space bound, actual dispatch composition and all-tape
final simulation ledger remain explicit Claude OWN proof work. This report grants no route change,

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/phase-interfaces-preship-v6/Second-scan-body-v1.lean.txt =====

/-- The second scan extends an already nonblank ruler; its physical start presentation is an
explicit prefix OWN interface, not a supplied proof that the entire prefix reaches it.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the public scan contract and ruler-extension reader at the existing
nonblank length. Public field equations and integer arithmetic identify the common ruler origin
and the two endpoint heads; their update equations preserve every other bank field. -/
theorem second_scan {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + ell1) (hq : d.state = some 0)
    (hh : d.workTapePos i = (ell1 : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a)
    (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ell1 = pairEncode u v) :
    let ell2 := 2 * u.length + 2
    let ht : d.inputPos.val + ell2 < z.length + 2 := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hz
      rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
      dsimp only [ell2]
      omega
    let c := headerScanCfg i d 3 ell2 ht
    (headerScanTM i).runFrom d ell2 = c ∧
      (∀ t < ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 3) ∧
      c.inputPos.val = 1 + (ell1 + ell2) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = ((ell1 + ell2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (ell1 + ell2) true) a) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → c.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).output = d.output) := by
  intro ell2 ht c
  obtain ⟨run, cut, silent⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d ell1 hp hq u v hz
  refine ⟨run, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, silent⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos]
    change d.inputPos.val + ell2 = 1 + (ell1 + ell2)
    omega
  · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ell2) i = _
    rw [Function.update_self, hh, Nat.cast_add]
  · intro a
    have hpre (b : ℤ) : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (ell1 : ℤ) + b) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) b := by
      simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw b
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ell2 ht ell1 hpre a
    simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using h
  · intro j hj
    constructor
    · funext a
      rw [headerScanCfg_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

end F6PhaseInterfaces
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.second_scan

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.MultiTapeTM.step Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.Cfg.init Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols Turing.moveInputPos Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime Turing.FinTM.ComputesFunInTime Turing.FinTM.Computes Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape Turing.MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead Turing.FinTM.controlAction Turing.FinTM.leftAction Turing.FinTM.rightAction Turing.FinTM.emitAction Turing.FinTM.bufferTape Turing.Cfg.mapState Turing.seamCompTM Turing.embedEmitTM Turing.embedEmitRetTM Turing.embedEmitCfg Turing.rulerHostCfg Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg Turing.startupLoopTM Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM Turing.pairEncode Turing.tableBitsK Turing.unaryFin Turing.tapeAction Turing.headerRulerTM Turing.headerScanTM Turing.headerScanCfg Turing.skipTM Turing.rewindTM
attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg

namespace F6PhaseInterfaces
open Turing
/-- The second scan extends an already nonblank ruler; its physical start presentation is an
explicit prefix OWN interface, not a supplied proof that the entire prefix reaches it.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the public scan contract and ruler-extension reader at the existing
nonblank length. Public field equations and integer arithmetic identify the common ruler origin
and the two endpoint heads; their update equations preserve every other bank field. -/
theorem second_scan {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (ell1 : ℕ)
    (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + ell1) (hq : d.state = some 0)
    (hh : d.workTapePos i = (ell1 : ℤ))
    (hw : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a)
    (u v : List Bool) (hz : z.drop ell1 = pairEncode u v) :
    let ell2 := 2 * u.length + 2
    let ht : d.inputPos.val + ell2 < z.length + 2 := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hz
      rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
      dsimp only [ell2]
      omega
    let c := headerScanCfg i d 3 ell2 ht
    (headerScanTM i).runFrom d ell2 = c ∧
      (∀ t < ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 3) ∧
      c.inputPos.val = 1 + (ell1 + ell2) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = ((ell1 + ell2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ a, c.workTapes i a = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (ell1 + ell2) true) a) ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ i → c.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ c.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) ∧
      (∀ t ≤ ell2, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d t).output = d.output) := by
  intro ell2 ht c
  obtain ⟨run, cut, silent⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d ell1 hp hq u v hz
  refine ⟨run, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, silent⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos]
    change d.inputPos.val + ell2 = 1 + (ell1 + ell2)
    omega
  · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
    change Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ell2) i = _
    rw [Function.update_self, hh, Nat.cast_add]
    dsimp only [ell2]
    omega
  · intro a
    have hpre (b : ℤ) : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - (ell1 : ℤ) + b) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) b := by
      simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using hw b
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ell2 ht ell1 hpre a
    simpa only [hh, sub_self, zero_add] using h
  · intro j hj
    constructor
    · funext a
      rw [headerScanCfg_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hj]
    · rw [headerScanCfg_workTapePos]
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

end F6PhaseInterfaces
#print axioms F6PhaseInterfaces.second_scan

/-- Skip, then the fixed one-cell correction, yields a literal next-scan presentation.
The full prefix run, dispatches and global space ledger remain Claude OWN obligations.

**Proof sketch.** Specialize the framed skip equation, relabel its live endpoint for the
already checked correction leaf, and use its actual one-step result. Public state-map fields
show the next scan starts at zero while every tape, native head and output is preserved. -/
theorem skip_correction_connection (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : MultiTapeTM (K + 4) Bool Bool, C.q₀ = false ∧
      ∀ (z : List Bool) (d : Cfg (K + 4) Bool SeekPhase z) (ell1 : ℕ),
        d.state = some .run → d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = 0 →
        (∀ a, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 3)) a =
          FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ell1 true) a) →
        let s := (skipTM (K + 4) (Fin.last (K + 3))).runFrom d (ell1 + 1)
        let e := s.mapState (fun _ => false)
        let f := (C.runFrom e 1).mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 4))
        f.state = some 0 ∧ f.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) ∧
          f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.output = d.output := by
  obtain ⟨C, q, correct⟩ := last_ruler_correction K
  refine ⟨C, q, ?_⟩
  intro z d ell1 hs hh hw s e f
  have skip := (skip_endpoint (Fin.last (K + 3)) d ell1 hs hh hw).1
  have es : e.state = some false := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_state, skip]
    rfl
  have eh : e.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 3)) = (ell1 : ℤ) + 1 := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, skip]
    exact Function.update_self _ _ _
  obtain ⟨run, cut, head⟩ := correct z e es
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, run]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    exact head ell1 eh
  · funext j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, run]
    change e.workTapes j a = d.workTapes j a
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, run]
    change e.inputPos = d.inputPos
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, skip]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, run]
    change e.output = d.output
    rw [Cfg.mapState_output, skip]

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/phase-interfaces-preship-v6/run-probe.py =====

```
"""One sequential plain elaboration through the managed wrapper, raw input and receipts retained."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=OUT.parents[4]
context=json.loads((OUT/'context.json').read_text())
name=sys.argv[1]
source=OUT/(name+'.lean.txt');log=OUT/(name+'.out');receipt=OUT/(name+'-run.json')
assert not log.exists() and not receipt.exists()
data=source.read_bytes();tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='tcslib-f6-preship-',dir='/private/tmp'))
p=tmp/(name.replace('-','_')+'.lean');p.write_bytes(data)
command=['bash',str(ROOT/'devtools/seyoon/leanelab.sh'),context['worktree'],context['snapshot'],str(p)]
start=time.time();row=dict(command=command,start_utc=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(start,datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),local_slots=os.environ.get('TCSLIB_LEAN_SLOTS'),plain_managed=True,no_outer_lock=True)
(OUT/(name+'-request.json')).write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
log.write_bytes(r.stdout);text=r.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
row.update(exit=r.returncode,seconds=time.time()-start,errors=len(re.findall(r'^.*:\d+:\d+: error(?:\([^)]*\))?:',text,re.M)),output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest())
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(row,indent=2));print(text)
```

from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,collections,datetime
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;H=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b.encode() if isinstance(b,str) else b).hexdigest();guard=(out/'guard.txt').read_text();names=guard.splitlines()[0].split('] ',1)[1].split();assert len(names)==len(set(names))==37
runs=[]
for p in sorted(out.glob('*-run.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text());stem=p.name.removesuffix('-run.json');assert r['input_sha256']==H((out/(stem+'.lean.txt')).read_bytes()) and r['output_sha256']==H((out/(stem+'.out')).read_bytes());runs.append({'name':stem,'exit':r['exit'],'errors':r['errors'],'seconds':r['seconds']})
for stem in ['Phases-v4','Phases-native-v4','Controls-unsealed-v1']:
 r=json.loads((out/(stem+'-run.json')).read_text());assert r['exit']==r['errors']==0
r=json.loads((out/'Controls-sealed-v1-run.json').read_text());assert r['exit']==1 and r['errors']==74
assert (out/'Phases-v4.lean.txt').read_text().replace(guard,'',1)==(out/'Phases-native-v4.lean.txt').read_text()
expected={(n,m) for n in names for m in ['point','abstract']};u=(out/'Controls-unsealed-v1.out').read_text();s=(out/'Controls-sealed-v1.out').read_text();passes=re.findall(r'CONTROL\|([^|\n]+)\|(point|abstract)\|PASS\|kernelChecked=',u);fails=re.findall(r'CONTROL\|([^|\n]+)\|(point|abstract)\|FAIL',s);errors=re.findall(r'RFL_CONTROL\|([^|\n]+)\|(point|abstract)\|',s)
def check(keys):
 c=collections.Counter(keys);assert set(c)==expected and all(v==1 for v in c.values()) and len(keys)==74
check(passes);check(fails);check(errors)
try:check([errors[0],errors[0]]+errors[2:])
except AssertionError:negative=True
else:raise AssertionError('duplicate/drop accepted')
proofs=[];foreign=[]

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
/-! Conditional consumer of the exact proposed whole-bundle equation.
The equation is a hypothesis, not a published or assumed new theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
attribute [local irreducible] Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM
namespace F6DraftProposedReader
open Turing

/-- Frozen-target computation and space premises convert through the proposed
bundle equation with the foreign definition sealed. -/
theorem conditional_bundle_consumer (M : CodeTM)
    (hEq : M.toFinTM = { k := 1, State := Fin (M.numStates + 1), tm := M.tm })
    (x output : List Bool) (t s : ℕ)
    (hcomp : M.toFinTM.ComputesInTime x output t)
    (hspace : M.toFinTM.tm.spaceUsed (M.toFinTM.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s) :
    (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
    (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output = output ∧
    M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s := by
  rw [hEq] at hcomp hspace
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff
    { k := 1, State := Fin (M.numStates + 1), tm := M.tm } x output t).mp hcomp
  exact ⟨hhalt, hout, hspace⟩

end F6DraftProposedReader
#print axioms F6DraftProposedReader.conditional_bundle_consumer

## ===== campaign/fills/f6/drafts/probes/ConditionalComponents.lean.txt =====

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Hierarchy

/-! Draft pre-ship component check. These are the four admission-free historical
U2-harvest compositions, rechecked in Hierarchy's import context. The withdrawn
arbitrary-machine route_space is excluded. This checks neither F6's concrete prefix
nor its hosted-startup live-anchor cut. -/
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace F6DraftConditional

open Turing

/-! ### §1 Two header scans, the ruler extended -/

/-- Two consecutive header scans from a blank ruler tape write the ruler `true^(ℓ₁ + ℓ₂)`, with
the input head just past both headers. -/
theorem two_scans {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 4) z) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : d.inputPos.val = 1 + p) (hd : d.state = some 0)
    (hblank : ∀ a, d.workTapes i a = none) (u₁ u₂ v : List Bool)
    (hz : z.drop p = pairEncode u₁ (pairEncode u₂ v)) :
    ((headerScanTM i).runFrom d (2 * u₁.length + 2)).state = some 3 ∧
      ((headerScanTM i).runFrom
          (((headerScanTM i).runFrom d (2 * u₁.length + 2)).mapState fun _ => 0)
          (2 * u₂.length + 2)).state = some 3 ∧
      ((headerScanTM i).runFrom
          (((headerScanTM i).runFrom d (2 * u₁.length + 2)).mapState fun _ => 0)
          (2 * u₂.length + 2)).inputPos.val =
        1 + p + (2 * u₁.length + 2) + (2 * u₂.length + 2) ∧
      ∀ a : ℤ, ((headerScanTM i).runFrom
          (((headerScanTM i).runFrom d (2 * u₁.length + 2)).mapState fun _ => 0)
          (2 * u₂.length + 2)).workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + a) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ((2 * u₁.length + 2) + (2 * u₂.length + 2)) true) a := by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d p hp hd u₁ (pairEncode u₂ v) hz
  rw [h1]
  set ℓ₁ := 2 * u₁.length + 2 with hℓ₁
  have hlen₁ : d.inputPos.val + ℓ₁ < z.length + 2 := by
    have h := congrArg List.length hz
    rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
    omega
  -- the second scan's start
  set d₂ := (headerScanCfg i d 3 ℓ₁ hlen₁).mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 4)) with hd₂
  have hp₂ : d₂.inputPos.val = 1 + (p + ℓ₁) := by
    rw [hd₂, Cfg.mapState_inputPos, headerScanCfg_inputPos, Fin.val_mk, hp]
    omega
  have hs₂ : d₂.state = some 0 := by
    rw [hd₂, Cfg.mapState_state, headerScanCfg_state, Option.map_some]
  have hz₂ : z.drop (p + ℓ₁) = pairEncode u₂ v := by
    rw [← List.drop_drop, hz, hℓ₁, pairEncode_drop]
  have hlen₂ : d₂.inputPos.val + (2 * u₂.length + 2) < z.length + 2 := by
    have h := congrArg List.length hz₂
    rw [List.length_drop, length_pairEncode] at h
    omega
  have hpos₂ : d₂.workTapePos i = d.workTapePos i + ℓ₁ := by
    rw [hd₂, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, headerScanCfg_workTapePos, Function.update_self]
  -- the first scan's ruler (`m = 0`), as the second scan's prefix (`m = ℓ₁`)
  have hfirst : ∀ a : ℤ, (headerScanCfg i d 3 ℓ₁ hlen₁).workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + a) =
      FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ₁ true) a := by
    intro a
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d 3 ℓ₁ hlen₁ 0 (fun b => by
      rw [hblank, List.replicate_zero, FinTM.bufferTape_eq, List.getElem?_nil, ite_self]) a
    simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, Nat.zero_add] using h
  have hpre₂ : ∀ a : ℤ, d₂.workTapes i (d₂.workTapePos i - (ℓ₁ : ℤ) + a) =
      FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ₁ true) a := by
    intro a
    rw [hpos₂, show d.workTapePos i + (ℓ₁ : ℤ) - ℓ₁ + a = d.workTapePos i + a by ring, hd₂,
      Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    exact hfirst a
  obtain ⟨h2, -, -⟩ := headerScanTM_run i d₂ (p + ℓ₁) hp₂ hs₂ u₂ v hz₂
  rw [h2]
  refine ⟨by rw [headerScanCfg_state], by rw [headerScanCfg_state], ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [headerScanCfg_inputPos, Fin.val_mk, hp₂]
    omega
  · intro a
    have h := headerScanCfg_ruler i d₂ 3 (2 * u₂.length + 2) hlen₂ ℓ₁ hpre₂ a
    rwa [hpos₂, show d.workTapePos i + (ℓ₁ : ℤ) - ℓ₁ + a = d.workTapePos i + a by ring] at h

/-! ### §2 The startup under the ruler host, on the first header's suffix -/

/-- The startup run under H5's ruler host on the suffix `pairEncode α x` of
`pairEncode u (pairEncode α x)`, with the first header's ruler `true^ℓ₁`: the host ends at the
startup's endpoint presented through `rulerHostCfg` (input head at `ℓ₁ + 1`, the bank holding
the startup's tapes, the ruler last), within `C · (ℓ₁ + 1) · T` steps, and uses the startup's
cells plus `ℓ₁ + 2`. -/
theorem hosted_startup {K k : ℕ} {P : Type} [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P]
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2)) Bool P) (u y : List Bool) (T B : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg (K + (k + 2)) Bool P y)
    (hrun : R.runFrom (R.initCfg y) T = d) (hB : R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg y) T ≤ B) :
    ∃ (V : Type) (_ : Fintype V) (_ : DecidableEq V) (H : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 2) + 1) Bool V)
      (inj : P → Bool → V) (C : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
      ∃ (hz : (pairEncode u y).length = (2 * u.length + 2) + y.length) (t' : ℕ) (b' : Bool),
        t' ≤ C * (2 * u.length + 2 + 1) * T ∧
        (H.runFrom (rulerHostCfg (2 * u.length + 2) hz (some (inj R.q₀ false)) (R.initCfg y)
            (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (2 * u.length + 2) true)) 0) t').inputPos.val =
          2 * u.length + 2 + d.inputPos.val ∧
        H.runFrom (rulerHostCfg (2 * u.length + 2) hz (some (inj R.q₀ false)) (R.initCfg y)
            (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (2 * u.length + 2) true)) 0) t' =
          rulerHostCfg (2 * u.length + 2) hz (d.state.map fun q => inj q b') d
            (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (2 * u.length + 2) true)) 0 ∧
        H.spaceUsed (rulerHostCfg (2 * u.length + 2) hz (some (inj R.q₀ false)) (R.initCfg y)
            (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (2 * u.length + 2) true)) 0) t' ≤
          B + (2 * u.length + 2 + 2) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V, fV, dV, H, inj, C, hC, hH⟩ := exists_rulerHostTM R
  refine ⟨V, fV, dV, H, inj, C, hC, ?_⟩
  set ℓ := 2 * u.length + 2 with hℓ
  have hz : (pairEncode u y).length = ℓ + y.length := length_pairEncode u y
  have hinit : (R.initCfg y).inputPos.val = 1 := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos]; rfl
  have hb : false = true ↔ (R.initCfg y).inputPos.val = 0 := by rw [hinit]; decide
  have hstate : (R.initCfg y).state.map (fun q => inj q false) = some (inj R.q₀ false) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state, Option.map_some]
  obtain ⟨t', -, ht', ⟨b', -, hend⟩, -, -, hbank, hruler⟩ :=
    hH ℓ hz (by omega) (pairEncode_drop u y) (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0
      (by intro p _ _; rw [zero_add]) (R.initCfg y) false hb T
  rw [hstate, hrun] at hend
  rw [hstate] at hbank hruler
  refine ⟨hz, t', b', ht', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hend]
    exact (rulerHostCfg_fields ℓ hz _ d _ 0).1
  · rw [hend]
  · -- the space ledger: the bank's cells are the startup's, the ruler's at most `ℓ + 2`
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have hbankle : ∑ i : Fin (K + (k + 2)), H.spaceUsedByTape
        (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (some (inj R.q₀ false)) (R.initCfg y)
          (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0) t' i.castSucc ≤ B := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ i : Fin (K + (k + 2)), R.spaceUsedByTape (R.initCfg y) T i := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card,
            hbank i]
        _ = R.spaceUsed (R.initCfg y) T := (MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum _ _).symm
        _ ≤ B := hB
    have hrulerle : H.spaceUsedByTape
        (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (some (inj R.q₀ false)) (R.initCfg y)
          (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0) t' (Fin.last _) ≤ ℓ + 2 := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
      calc
        _ ≤ (Finset.Icc ((0 : ℤ) - 1) (0 + ℓ)).card := Finset.card_le_card hruler
        _ = ℓ + 2 := by rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
    omega

/-! ### §3 The final seam: the suffix-ruler layout into the ruler host around H2-F -/

/-- From any prefix machine `A` that ends at the suffix-ruler layout with a ruler of length `ℓ`
(F6: `ℓ = ℓ₁ + ℓ₂`, two headers), the seam machine runs the ruler host `H` around the forwarding
loop on the suffix `x`, and its space is `A`'s plus `(K + (k + 3)) · S` for a per-tape bound `S`
of the hosted loop. -/
theorem final_seam {k K n : ℕ} {P Q V : Type} [DecidableEq P]
    (A : MultiTapeTM (K + (k + 3)) Bool P) (finish : P)
    (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 3) Bool V) (inj : Q → Bool → V) (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) {z x : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ)
    (hz : z.length = ℓ + x.length) (hlen : ℓ + 1 < z.length + 2) (T : ℕ)
    (aRun : A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) T = suffixRulerCfg (K := K) finish M z ℓ hlen)
    (aCut : ∀ u < T, (A.runFrom (A.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some finish)
    (t B S : ℕ) (hB : A.spaceUsed (A.initCfg z) T ≤ B) (hS : 1 ≤ S)
    (hloop : ∀ i, H.spaceUsedByTape
      (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz ((StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).state.map
        fun q => inj q false) (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
        (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0) t i ≤ S) :
    (startupLoopTM (k := k + 1) A finish H (inj entry false)).runFrom
        ((startupLoopTM (k := k + 1) A finish H (inj entry false)).initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) =
      (embedEmitCfg (Fin.castLEEmb (by omega : k + 1 + 2 ≤ K + (k + 1 + 2)))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
        (H.runFrom (rulerHostCfg ℓ hz
          ((StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x)).state.map fun q => inj q false)
          (StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.initCfg x))
          (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true)) 0) t)).mapState Sum.inr ∧
    (startupLoopTM (k := k + 1) A finish H (inj entry false)).spaceUsed
        ((startupLoopTM (k := k + 1) A finish H (inj entry false)).initCfg z) (T + 1 + t) ≤
      B + (K + (k + 1 + 2)) * S := by
  have hcfg := (suffixRulerCfg_embed (K := K) finish entry inj M ℓ hz hlen).symm
  have hexit : (suffixRulerCfg (K := K) finish M z ℓ hlen).state = some finish :=
    suffixRulerCfg_state _ _ _ _ _
  exact ⟨startupLoopTM_runFrom (k := k + 1) A finish H (inj entry false) _ _ T aRun hexit
      aCut hcfg t,
    startupLoopTM_spaceUsed_le (k := k + 1) A finish H (inj entry false) _ _ T aRun hexit
      aCut hcfg t B S hB hS hloop⟩

/-! ### §4 The route at F6's layout `pairEncode (bits s) (pairEncode α x)` -/

/-- F6's layout: the two headers' lengths add up to the suffix-ruler layout's `ℓ`, and the
suffix after both is `x`. -/
theorem layout (u α x : List Bool) :
    (pairEncode u (pairEncode α x)).length =
        ((2 * u.length + 2) + (2 * α.length + 2)) + x.length ∧
      (pairEncode u (pairEncode α x)).drop ((2 * u.length + 2) + (2 * α.length + 2)) = x := by
  refine ⟨by rw [length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; omega, ?_⟩
  rw [← List.drop_drop, pairEncode_drop, pairEncode_drop]

end F6DraftConditional
